sa: सीदमाने रथे चैव नर्दमानेषु शत्रुषु। स सम्भ्रमात तु भगवान् नादं चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: While, indeed, that car was going down and the enemies were uttering loud roars, then the illustrious lord, who was possessed of immense prowess, made a very tremendous roar out of rage.

sa: तेषां सुलुलिते सैन्ये पुनर्भीमो महाबलः॥ नन्दोपनन्दौ समरे प्रेषयद् यमसादनम्।
en: When your army was once more agitated Bhima sent Nanda and Upananda in that great battle to the abode of the Regent of death.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच न मर्षणीयाः संग्रामे विश्रमन्तः श्रमान्विताः। सपत्ना ग्लानमनसो लब्धलक्ष्या विशेषतः॥ :॥
en: Duryodhana said No quarter should have been granted to our enemies when they were depressed at heart and exhausted with fatigue and taking rest, especially as they are ever of sure aim.

sa: यत् तु मर्षितमस्माभिर्भवतः प्रियकाम्यया। त एते परिविश्रान्ताः पाण्डवा बलवत्तराः॥
en: That we showed them mercy was only from a desire for pleasing you. The fatigued Pandavas, however, have now (after taking rest) become stronger.

sa: स विक्षरन् नाग इव प्रभिन्नो गदामस्मै तुमुले प्राहिणोद् वै। तयाहरद् दश धन्वन्तराणि दुःशासनं भीमसेनः प्रसह्य॥
en: In that fearful fight when thus struck the prince, with his mace, resembled an unruly elephant from whose body fatty sweat was flowing down. Struck down by that weapon Dushasana fell at a distance of ten bows from his car.

sa: शरवृष्टिं तु तां मुक्तां सूतपुत्रेण भारत॥ व्यधमच्छरवर्षेण सम्पन्निव धनंजयः।
en: The arrowy shower, sent forth by the charioteer's son, was baffled by Dhananjaya with discharges of arrows, as if with a smile, O Bharata.

sa: कृपायमाणः कौन्तेयः कृपं नवभिरार्दयत्॥ शल्यं षोडशभिर्बाणैः कर्णं द्वात्रिंशता शरैः।
en: Compassionate as the son of Kunti was, he pierced Kripa with nine arrows. He pierce Slay with sixteen and Karna with thirty two arrows.

sa: स कर्ण शरजालेन च्छादयामास पाण्डवः॥ ततः कर्णः सुसंरब्धः शरैसिभिरविध्यत।
en: (And) the son of Pandu covered Karna with a dense shower of arrows. Then Karna greatly excited with rage pierced him with three darts,

sa: महारथान् नागवनरान् हयांश्च पदातिमुख्यानपि च प्रमथ्य। एको भीमो धार्तराष्ट्रेषु मग्नः स मामुपालब्धुमरिंदमोऽर्हति॥
en: He, who has been diving single-handed deep into the surge of Duryodhana's soldiers, carrying by storm the foremost elephants, steeds, infantry and charioteers; that Bhimsena, the slayer of foes, may reprove me.

sa: समकम्पन्त सैन्यानि पाण्डवानां विशाम्पते। भ्राजमानं श्रिया युक्तं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा॥ द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा परे त्रेसुश्चेरुर्मम्लुश्च भारत। आह्वयन्तं परानीकं प्रभिन्नमिव वारणम्॥
en: O ruler of men, the Pandava troops began to tremble. Beholding Drona exceedingly handsome and attended with prosperity and burning in his own effulgence, the soldiers of the enemy were affrighted, depressed and routed, O Bharata.-Challenging the hostile host as he stood, like an infuriate elephant in rut.

sa: बाह्नीको याज्ञसेनि तु हेमपुजैः शिलाशितैः। आजघान भूशं क्रुद्धो नवभिनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Thereupon Balhika also inflamed with rage, deeply struck Yajnasena's son with nine shafts of depressed knot, whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings.

sa: बभूवायोधनं रौद्रं वैवस्वतपुरोपमम्। ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: The field of battle looked like the region of the son of Vivasvata, O king. Then, 0 monarch, beholding the feats of Karna, Duryodhana.

sa: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्वासुदेवेन पाण्डवः। मनसा पूजयामास भूरिश्रवसमाहवे॥
en: The mighty-armed son of Pandu thus spoken to by Vasudeva (Krishna), worshipped Bhurisravas in his minds.

sa: स भवान् मयि निक्षेपो निक्षिप्तः सव्यसाचिना। भारद्वाजाद् भयं नित्यं मन्यमानेन वै प्रभो॥
en: Thus do you see, O king, that you have been made over to me as sacred trust by Savyasachin, afraid as he ever is of the son of Bharadvaja, on your account.

sa: ततस्ते प्राद्रवन् भीताः प्रतीपं प्रहिताः पुनः। महामात्रैस्तामवतुर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥
en: Then filled with fear those animals ran away. But again urged on by their drivers they surrounded Bhimasena like the clouds covering the sun.

sa: कुरवः सहपञ्चाला: शाल्वा मत्स्याः सनैमिषाः। कोसलाः काशपौण्ड्राश्च कालिङ्गा मागधास्तथा।॥ चेदयंश्च महाभागा धर्मं जानान्ति शाश्वतम्। नानादेशेषु सन्तंश्च प्रायो बाह्यलयादृते॥
en: Kauravas with the Panchalas, the Shalyas, the Matsyas, the Naimishas, the Koshalas, the Kashapaunctras, the Kalingas, the Maghadas and the Chedis, who are all blessed, are conversant with the eternal religion. Even the wicked of every country know what religion is; the Balhikas are however divested of piety.

sa: संजय उवाच दुःशासनरथं दृष्टवा समीपे पर्यवस्थितम्। भारद्वाजस्ततो वाक्यं दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding then the chariot of Dussana stationed near him, the son of Bharadvaja addressing him said these wordsदुःशासन रथाः सर्वे कस्माच्चैते प्रविद्रुताः।

sa: पलायने तव मतिः संग्रामाद्धि प्रवर्तते। यदा गाण्डीवधन्वानं भीमसेनं च कौरव॥ यमौ वा युधि द्रष्टासि तदा त्वं कि करिष्यसि। युधि फाल्गुनबाणानां सूर्याग्निसमवर्चसाम्॥ न तुल्याः सात्यकिशराः येषां भीतः पलायसे।
en: Your heart is inclined to fly away from battle. What then, O Kaurava, will you do when you will see the wielder of the Gandiva in battle or Bhimasena of the twins, Nakula and Sahadeva. The arrows of Satyaki, afraid of which you are seeking to fly away, are scarcely equal to those of Arjuna, that resemble the sun or the fire in effulgence? If your heart is intent on flying away.

sa: धनुः शरांश्च चिच्छेद सूतं चाभ्यहनच्छरैः॥ भीमसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धो गदामादाय पाण्डवः।
en: Cut off his bow and arrows and wounded his driver with numerous shafts. Thereupon Pandu's son Bhimasena, burning with rage, took up a mace.

sa: ततः शरं महाघोरं सूर्यपावकसंनिभम्। संदधे परवीरघ्नो वीरकेतो रथं प्रति॥
en: Thereafter that slayer of hostile heroes viz., Drona aimed at the chariot of Viraketu a dreadful shaft, resembling the sun or fire in splendour.

sa: कुञ्जराणां च पततां हयौघानां च भारत। अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी मांसशोणितकर्दमा।॥
en: Miry with the flesh and blood of all the elephants and horses fallen in the battle, O Bharata, the earth appeared to he impassable.

sa: न्यस्यायुधं रणे द्रोण समीक्षास्मानवस्थितान्। नातः क्रूरतरं कर्म पुनः कर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Cast away your weapons, O Drona and look at us standing before you. Hence-forward it behoves you not to perform cruel acts like these.

sa: तस्मात् तं परिपप्रच्छ नान्यं कञ्चिद् द्विजर्षभः। तस्मिंस्तस्य हि सत्याशा बाल्यात् प्रभृति पाण्डय।।४४
en: For that reason, that foremost of the regenerate ones questioned Yudhishthira in exclusion of every body else. Since the days of the latter's boyhood, Drona had hoped to hear truth from him.

sa: निपातात्तव शस्त्राणां शरीरे याभवद् रुजा। तया ते मानुषं कर्म व्यपोढं भृगुनन्दन॥ गृहाणास्त्राणि दिव्यानि मत्सकाशाद् यथेप्सितम्।
en: The wounds, caused upon your body by the falling of innumerable weapons testify to the u superhuman act performed by you. O delighter of Bhrigu's race, do you, therefore, accept these numerous celestial weapons from me, according to your desire.

sa: अथैनं तत्र संलीनमस्पृशद् धनुषा पुनः। प्रहसंश्च पुनर्वाक्यं भीममाह वृषस्तदा॥
en: And once more as Bhima greatly weakened stood there, Vrishasena poked him with horn of his bow and smilingly addressed these words to him.

sa: कर्ण उवाच परित्रातुमिह प्राप्तो यदि पार्थं पुरंदरः। तमप्याशु पराजित्य ततो हन्तास्मि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Karna said Even if Purandara himself comes here in person in order to deliver the son of Pritha, I will soon vanquish him and then slay the son of Pandu (i.e. Arjuna).

sa: एते नदन्ति संहृष्टाः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः। शक्रोपमाश्च बहवः पञ्चालानां स्थव्रजाः॥
en: These Pandavas, filled with ecstasy and desirous of victory and these numerous carwarriors of the Panchalas equal to Shakra in prowess, are (all) roaring.

sa: नैवाददानं न च संदधानं जानीमहे कतरेणास्यतीति। वामेन वा यदि वा दक्षिणेन स द्रोणपुत्रः समरे पर्यवर्तत्॥
en: So quickly did he move about in the battlefield that we could not discern from which side did he shoot his arrows, right or left, nor could we ascertain when he took up the arrows and when he discharged them.

sa: माधवस्य तु विद्धस्य तोमरेण महारणे। प्रतोदः प्रापतद्धस्ताद रश्मयश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: O lord of earth, the whip and reins of Madhava, who was pierced with lance in that dreadful battle, dropped down from his hands.

sa: सर्वाण्यत्राणि धर्मात्मा हातुकामोऽभ्यभाषत। कर्ण कर्ण महेष्वास कृप दुर्योधनेति च॥
en: Then desirous of laying all his weapons aside, Bharadvaja's son of illustrious soul, said aloud-"O Karna, O Karna, Ogreat bowman, O Kripa, O Duryodhana.

sa: ध्वजमस्य समासाद्य तस्थौ भीमो महीतले। तदस्य कुरवः सर्वे चारणाश्चाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Bhima, catching hold of the former's flagstaff, remained on the ground. Then all the Kurus and the Charanas applauded that feat of his, viz.,

sa: वासुदेवश्च वार्ष्णेयो धर्मपुत्रश्च पाण्डवः। अन्ये त सर्वे नापश्यन् भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः॥ महिमानं महाराज योगयुक्तस्य गच्छतः। ब्रह्मलोकं महद् दिव्यं देवगुह्यं हि तत् परम्॥
en: Vasudeva of the Vrisni race and king Yudhishthira the virtuous son of Pandu, All else could not seen the halo of glory that surrounded the intelligent son of Bharadvaja as he ascended, rapt up in yoga, to the Brahma regions, which are mysterious even to the gods and which is the highest of all celestial regions.

sa: न्यवधीत् सायकै?रैः सिन्धुराजस्य रक्षिणः॥ द्रौणिं कृपं कर्णशल्यौ वृषसेनं सुयोधनम्। छादयामास तीव्रण शरजालेन पाण्डवः॥ न गृह्णन् न क्षिपन् राजन् मुञ्चन्नापि च संदधत्। अदृश्यतार्जुनः संख्ये शीघ्रास्रत्वात् कथंचन॥ धनुर्मण्डलमेवास्य दृश्यते स्मास्यतः सदा। सायकाश्च व्यदृश्यन्त निश्चरन्तः समन्ततः॥ कर्णस्य तु धनुश्छित्त्वा वृषसेनस्य चैव ह।
en: Began to wound with dreadful shafts the protectors of the Sindhu ruler. The son of Pandu then covered with his arrowy showers Karna, Drona's son, Kripa, Shalya, Vrishasena and Duryodhana. Arjuna was quick in the use of weapons that none was able to notice when he took out his arrows, fixed them on the bowstring and stretched the bow and discharged them. Thus when he was engaged in wounding the foe, his bow was seen incessantly drawn to a circle. Thousands of shafts were seen to issue out from his bow and to scatter in all directions. Then severing off Karna's and Vrishasena's bow.

sa: क्षीबा इवान्ये चोन्मत्ता रङ्गेष्विव च वारणाः। उच्चुक्रुशुरथान्योन्यं जघ्नुरन्योन्यमेव च॥
en: Many infuriate elephants as if perfectly mad, uttered loud shrieks and killed one another, after the manner they do so in arenas of sport.

sa: ननाद नादं सुमहानुभावो विद्ध्वेव शक्रं नमुचिः स वीरः। र्बाणैरविद्धयद् भुजमूले तु सव्ये॥
en: Vrishasena then re-attacked at the root of the Arjuna's left arm, injured again Krishna by shooting nine arrows and injured Arjuna, the son of Kunti again with ten arrows shot on him.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः संरम्भी दृढविक्रमः। अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य शरैर्विव्याधय सूतजम्॥
en: Thereafter, the mighty-armed and wrathful Bhima of resolute prowess, repulsing the weapons of Karna by his own, began to pierce that son of Suta.

sa: प्रद्रुतं च रथ दृष्ट्वा धृष्टधुम्नस्य मारिष॥ किरशतशतान्येव गौतमोऽनुययौ तदा।
en: O sire, Gautama, after witnessing that the car of Dhrishtadyumna was with-drawing from the field, then followed it, shooting hundreds of arrows at it.

sa: कुशल्यहं कुशलिनं समासाद्य धनंजयम्। हते जयद्रथे राजन् पुनरेष्यामि तेऽन्तिकम्॥
en: Safely shall I reach Dhananjaya who is also safe and after the slaughter of Jayadratha, we both shall come back to you, O king.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो द्रोणं नवन्या नतपर्वणाम्। अजघ्ने भरतश्रेष्ठः सर्वमर्मसु भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, that best of the Bharatas, viz., king Yudhishthira pierced Drona on all his vital limbs with ninety shafts of depressed knots.

sa: सूतपुत्रस्य संरम्भाद् दीप्तं वपुरजायत। स विस्फार्य महचापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम्॥ भीमं प्रेक्षत राधेयो घोरं घोरेण चक्षुषा। ततः क्रुद्धः शरानस्यन् सूतपुत्रो व्यरोचत॥ मध्यंदिनगतोऽर्चिष्माशरदीव दिवाकरः।
en: T'he body of Suta's son blazed up with radiance, in consequence of wrath. Thereupon stretching his terrible bow decked with gold. The son of Radha. O monarch, looked at Bhima with eyes flashing rage. Inflamed with rage the son of Suta, while discharging his shafts, looked beautiful. Like the autumnal sun of burning rays at mid-day.

sa: मुहुर्मुहुरुदीर्यन्ते कम्पयन्त्यपि मामकान्। य एष तुमुल: शब्दः श्रूयते लोमहर्षणः॥
en: This tremendous sound that is assailing our ears, causing our hair to stand erect, Meseems, will devour up the three worlds with their lords.

sa: पुत्रस्तु तव सम्भ्रान्तो विविंशो रथामारुहत्। शतानीकोऽपि त्वरितः प्रतिविन्ध्यरथं गतः॥
en: Thereupon your son, who became highly terrified, ascended the ascended the car of Vivingsa. Shatanika, too, with rapidity, mounted upon the car of Prativindhya.

sa: पश्यैनं भीमसेनेन ग्रस्तमाहवशोभिनम्॥ यदि त्वासाद्य मुच्येत विस्मयः सुमहान् भवेत्।
en: Behold he has been overpowered by Bhimasena, a beauty of the battle field. It will be a great wonder if you can release him.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन सूतपुत्रं स्तनान्तरे। आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धो हसन्निव वृकोदरः॥
en: Then excited to the highest pitch of anger, Vrikodara with the greatest ease struck Suta's son on the breast with a broad headed arrow,

sa: संजय उवाच कर्णोपि शरजालेन केकयानां महारथान्। व्यधमत् परमेष्वासानग्रतः पर्यवस्थितान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Karna, with a net-work of arrows, struck the mighty car-warrior, the great bowman of the Kekaya race who all stood before him.

sa: कर्णोऽपि भृशसंक्रुद्धो धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। नाराचैरर्धचन्द्रश्च वत्सदन्तैश्च संयुगे॥ अमर्षी क्रोधनश्चैव रोषप्रस्फुरिताननः। सायकैरप्रमेयात्मा युधिष्ठिरमभिद्रवत्॥
en: Then Karna, greatly worked up with anger, struck Yudhishthira with winged and calf-tooth shaped arrows. Revengeful, wrathful and having his lips trembling in anger the highly energetic Karna struck Yudhishthira with arrows.

sa: हतो विकर्णो राजेन्द्र चित्रसेनश्च वीर्यवान्। प्रवराश्चात्मजानां ते सुताश्चान्ये महारथाः॥
en: O foremost of kings, Vikarna and the puissant Chitrasena, have been slain; as also numerous other mighty car-warriors and your other sons have fallen.

sa: युवराजश्च विंशत्या द्रौणिं विव्याध पत्रिभिः। पार्थश्च पुनरष्टाभिस्तथा सर्वे त्रिभित्रिभिः॥
en: The youthful prince of the Chedis pierced Drona's son with twenty winged shafts, Partha with eight and all the rest with three arrows each.

sa: इति सूर्यस्यत चैवासीद् विवादो वासवस्य च। पक्षसंस्थितयोस्तत्र तयोर्विबुधसिंहयोः। द्वैपक्ष्यमासीद् देवानामसुराणां च भारत॥
en: Thus they of lion like-prowess disputed for each other taking different sides. Seeing those two noble warriors face each other in fight the Asuras took one side and the gods the other.

sa: संजय उवाच अश्रद्धेयमचिन्यं च कर्म तस्य महात्मनः। वृष्णयन्धकप्रवीरस्य श्रुत्वा मे व्यथितं मनः॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, the exertion and din that were then made by your troops, O king, teeming with cars, elephants, foot-soldiers, resembled that which occurs at the end of a Yuga.

sa: स पौरवं रथशक्त्या निहत्य छित्त्वा रथं तिलशश्चास्य बाणैः। छित्त्वा च बाहू वरचन्दनाक्ती भल्लेन कायाच्छिर उच्चकर्त॥
en: Then piercing Paurava with a lance and cutting off his chariot into smaller fragments, by means of his shafts, Ashvatthaman severed the two sandal-smeared arms of his opponent; and then with a bhalla he severed his head from his trunk.

sa: त्वं च दुर्योधन बलं यदि शक्तोऽसि पालय। रात्रावपि च योत्स्यन्ते संरब्धाः कुरुसृञ्जयाः॥
en: As for your, O Duryodhana, if you are capable, go and protect your army, for both the Kurus and the Srinjayas, that are furious (with rage) will fight even during the night.

sa: ध्वजयष्टिं समासाद्य न्यमीलयत लोचने। स मुहूर्तात् पुनः संज्ञांलब्वा द्रौणिर्नराधिप॥
en: Caught for support his flag-staff and shout his two eyes (in pain). But in a moment regaining his consciousness that on of Drona, Oking.

sa: आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः पाण्डवं निशितैः शरैः। ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय भीमसेनो ह्यमर्षणः॥
en: Wrathfully struck Pandu's son on the breast with extremely keen darts. Thereat filled with a eager desire for revenge Bhimasena took up another bow.

sa: योधे त्वयि रथस्ये च मद्रराजे च सारथौ। संख्ये पार्थनभिभविष्यति॥
en: With you as the warrior on that car and the king of Madra as the charioteer it will, forsooth, defeat the Parthas in battle.

sa: तेन शब्देन महता पूरितेयं वसुंधरा। सशैला सार्णवद्वीपा सपाताला विशाम्पते॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, with that loud sound, the earth seemed to be filled, with its mountains, seas, islands and the subterranean regions.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन हा चिच्छेद सारथेः कायाच्छिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्॥
en: Then with another well-tempered and sharpened shaft, he severed the head of his charioteer from his trunk, head that was graced with effulgent ear-rings.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा गुडाकेशं धर्मराजो महायशाः। पस्पर्श पुण्यगन्धेन पृष्ठे हस्तेन पार्थिवः॥
en: The great illustrious king Yudhishthira with these words to Arjuna, the conqueror of sheep, patted on his back with his hand with sheer love.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच आपगेयं हतं श्रुत्वा द्रोणं चापि महारथम्। आजगाम परामार्तिं वृद्धो राजाऽम्बिकासुतः॥
en: Janamejaya said Having heard that both Bhishma and the car-warrior Drona of indomitable courage were slain (in the battle), the old king (Dhritarashtra) the son of Ambika, was highly oppressed with sorrow.

sa: राजानं च समासाद्य गान्धारी भरतर्षभ। निःसंज्ञा पतिता भूमौ सर्वाण्यन्तः पुराणि च ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race advancing towards the king, Gandhari, as well as all other ladies of the royal household, fell down upon the ground, all having lost their senses. a

sa: तलेन नाशयामास कर्णस्यैवाग्रतः स्थितः। कर्णस्तु पाण्डवे शक्तिं काञ्चनीं समवासृजत्॥
en: And he (then) killed him with a slap in the very presence of Karna himself. Karna then shot a golden dart at that Pandava.

sa: ये मदर्थं परीप्सन्ते वसुधां वसुधाधिपाः। ते हित्वा वसुधैश्वर्यं वसुधामधिशेरते॥
en: Those lords of the earth, who desired for me the sovereignty of the earth, having abandoned all earthly prosperity, are lying on the earth.

sa: ते हयाश्चन्द्रसंकाशाः केशवेन प्रचोदिताः। आपिबन्त इव व्योम जग्मुद्रौणिरथं प्रति॥
en: Urged on by the Keshava those horses, effulgent like the moon, ran towards the car of Drona's son as if devouring the very sky.

sa: ततः पुनरमेयात्मा धर्मराजस्य कार्मुकम्॥ द्रौणिश्चिच्छेद विहसन् विव्याध च शरैस्त्रिभिः।
en: Just after this the highly spirited son of Drona, casting smiling look upon Yudhishthira, simultaneously cut-off his bow and struck him with three arrows.

sa: संनिवार्य महाबाणांस्तवं पुत्रेण प्रेषितान्। अथास्मै सुबहून् बाणान् प्रेषयामास संयुगे॥
en: Having thus restrained those powerful arrows, shot by your son, he (Shahadeva) sent away innumerable shafts against him (his antagonist) in that dreadful battle.

sa: विराटपुत्रः शङ्खस्तु उत्तरश्च महारथः। कुर्वन्तौ सुमहत् कर्म गतौ वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Having achieved the tasks most difficult to perform, the sons of Virata, Sankha and Uttara of mighty strengths departed to the abode of Death.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच मामकस्यास्य सैन्यस्य हृतोत्सेकस्य संजय। अवशेषं न पश्यामि ककुदे मृदिते सति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, when the most exalted of my heroes were slain, I do not see the survival of the rest of warriors on my side that had escaped the destruction.

sa: अद्य द्रष्टासि गोविन्द कर्णमुन्मथितं मया। वारणेनेव मत्तेन पुष्पितं जगतीरुहम्॥
en: As the furious elephant destroys a tree with all its blossoms and flowers in anger so O Govinda, I will knock him down today.

sa: विप्रहीणरथाश्चैव शरैश्च परकर्षिताः॥ पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्त्राः कालमार्थन् पदातयः।
en: Twenty-five thousand foot soldiers, deprived of cars, were killed there with arrows (by Bhima and Dhristadyumna).

sa: न हि मे जीवितेनार्थस्तानृते पुरुषर्षभान्। आचार्यः पाण्डुपुत्राणामनुजानातु नो भवान्॥
en: There is no good of my life without those foremost of men. O preceptor of the sons of Pandu, permit me to do this.

sa: विषमग्निं प्रपातं च पर्वतग्रादहं वृणे। न हि शक्ष्यामि दुःखानि सोढुं कष्टानि संजय॥
en: I desire (to swallow) poison, (to be burnt in) fire and the fall from the summit of a mountain; for I am indeed unable, O Sanjaya, to bear the grief and pain.

sa: हत्वा च सहितौ कृष्णौ तयोर्वित्तानि सर्वशः। तस्मै प्रबूयात् केशवार्जुनौ॥
en: I shall give him who will find out Keshava and Arjuna all the riches that will be left by them after slaying these two.

sa: विनष्टान् कौरवान् मन्ये मम पुत्रस्य दुर्नयैः। न हि कर्णो महेष्वासान् पार्थाञ्जेष्यति संजय॥
en: I regard the Kauravas as already slain, in consequence of the evil policy of my son. O Sanjaya, Karna will never be able to vanquish the sons of Pritha, those illustrious bowmen.

sa: सात्वतस्यापि कं युद्धे प्रेषयिष्ये पदानुगम् करिष्यामि प्रयत्नेन भ्रातुरन्वेषणं यदि॥
en: me Whom shall I now sent in the track of that Satvata hero, If now I strive to get information of my brother only.

sa: तान् सोऽभिपत्य जिज्ञासुः क एषां श्रेष्ठभागिति॥ उच्छिष्टदर्पितः काको बहूनां दूरपातिनाम्। तेषां यं प्रवरं मेने हंसानां दूरपातिनाम्॥ तमाह्वयत दुर्बुद्धिः पताव इति पक्षिणम्।
en: Proud of the leavings on which he fed the crow, approaching the swans who were capable of traversing a great distance, desired to enquire who amongst them was the leader. That foolish crow challenged him whom he considered as the leader amongst those swans capable of going to a great distance, saying-“Let us compete in fight."

sa: सौमदत्तिं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा शल्यं च दशभिः शरैः॥ शितैरग्निशिखाकारैौणिं विव्याध चाष्टभिः।
en: He piercing Somadatta's son with three and Shalya with ten arrows and pierced Drona's son with eight shafts, well-sharpened and resembling tongues of fire.

sa: जहि शत्रुगणान् सर्वान् महेन्द्रो दानवानिव। अवस्थितं रणे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवास्त्वां महारथाः॥ द्रविष्यन्ति च पञ्चाला विष्णुं दृष्ट्वेव दानवाः। तस्मात् त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र प्रकर्षैतां महाचमूम्॥
en: Do you slay all the foes, even as Mahendra slays the Danavas. When the most powerful car-warriors, the Pandavas, will see you waiting in the field of battle, they will surely fly away with all the Panchalas, even as the Danavas fly away, beholding Vishnu. Consequently, O foremost of men, do you command this mighty force.

sa: ततः पाञ्चालराजश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष। यमौ च युयुधानश्च सहिताः कर्णमभ्ययुः॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, the king of the Panchalas, the sons of Draupadi, the twin brothers and Yuyudhana, who all gathered together, advanced against Karna.

sa: ततस्तु त्वरयन् योधाशङ्खशब्देन मारिष। कर्णो निष्कर्षयामास कौरवाणां महद् बलम्॥
en: Thereupon, O sire Karna, having ordered the warriors to make haste by the sound of his conch, led the vast army of the Kauravas.

sa: कचित् सैन्धवको राजा दुर्योधनहिते रतः॥ नन्दयिष्यत्यमित्रान् हि फाल्गुनेन निपातितः।
en: Will the ruler of the Sindhus ever anxious for achieving the good of king Duryodhana, afford delight unto his foes, being slain by Phalguna.

sa: तेषां निनदतां चैव शस्त्रवर्षं च मुश्चताम्। बहूनाधिरथिर्वीरः प्रममाथेषुभिः परान्॥
en: The warlike son of Adhiratha crushed, with innumerable arrows, large numbers of these enemies, who uttered loud roars and poured forth showers of weapons.

sa: ते क्षत्रिया दह्यमानास्त्रिभिस्तैः पावकोपमैः। जग्मुर्विनाश समरे राजन् दुर्मत्रिते तव॥
en: For your bad policy, O king, all these Kshatriyas, burnt down, as it were, by those three heroes resembling three burning flames, got exterminated.

sa: तथा तस्मिन् बले शूरैर्वध्यमाने हतेऽपि च। अस्मानभ्याययुः पार्था वृकोदरपुरोगमाः॥
en: While the army was being thus smitten and slain by the horses, the sons of Pritha with Vrikodara at their head proceeded against us.

sa: हाहाकारो महानासीत् त्रिगर्तानां जनेश्वर। राजपुत्रं हतं दृष्ट्वा निरमित्रं महारथम्॥
en: O ruler of men, beholding the son of their king, the mighty car-warrior Niramitra slain, the Trigarttas uttered loud cries of 'Oh and Alas.'

sa: तस्मै व्यसृजदुग्राणि विविधानि परंतपः। अमर्षात् पाण्डवः क्रुद्धः शरवर्षाणि मारिष।॥
en: That vindictive son of Pandu, excited with wrath, that slayer of foes, O sire, began to discharge at Karna many showers of fearful arrows.

sa: बाणभूते ततस्तस्मिन् संछन्ने च नभस्तले॥ यमाभ्यो ददृशे रूपं कालान्तकयमोपमम्।
en: When the firinament was thus covered and the whole sky looked like a sheet of arrows the twin brothers appeared like the destroyer himself.

sa: तौ विदार्य महासेनां प्रविष्टौ केशवार्जुनौ॥ क्रुद्धौ संरम्भरक्ताक्षौ व्यभ्राजेतां महाद्युती।
en: When cutting through the vast army, Keshava and Arjuna entered the arena with their eyes blooded with anger they looked exceedingly splendid and resplendent.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे को गजानीकमुपाद्रवत्। द्रावयामास स तदा पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्॥
en: Within a very short time Karna proceeded most rapidly against the clephant-force belonging to the Pandavas, as also then rushed against their vast army.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ ततः शूरौ व्यतिक्रम्य महारथौ।॥ धृष्टद्युम्नस्तव सुतं वारयामास सायकैः।
en: Violating the regimental order of those two great car-warriors, the two brave sons of Madri, Dhristadyumna began to oppose your son with his arrows.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन तीक्ष्णेन निशितेन च। जहार सशिरस्त्राणं शिरस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Thereupon he had severed the head of that high-souled one, that was adorned with an (iron) protection, with another broad-headed, pointed and sharp-headed arrow.

sa: ततो द्रौणि रणे भीमो यतमानं पराक्रमी। त्रिभिर्विव्याध नाराचैर्ललाटे विस्मयन्निव॥
en: Then Bhima of immense prowess smilingly pierced the son of Drona, who attempted very hard in the battle, in the forehead with three shafts.

sa: संजय उवाच धृष्टद्युम्नमुखान् पार्थान् दृष्ट्वा कर्णो व्यवस्थितान्। समभ्यधावत्त्वरितः पञ्चालाञ्छत्रुकर्षिणः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing the followers of the Pandavas led by Dhristadyumna stationed for battle, Karna, the subduer of foes, rushed furiously against the Panchalas.

sa: यज्ञसेनस्तु समरे कर्णपुत्रं महारथम्। षष्ट्या शराणां विव्याध बाह्वोरुरसि चानघ॥
en: Yajnasena also, O lord, pierced in that battle, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Karna, in the arm and the chest with six arrows.

sa: प्रत्यपश्यच्च स विभुञ्जतिक्षयमधोक्षजः॥ समुपेक्षितवान् नित्यं स्वयं स मम पुत्रकः।
en: Alas, being powerful Vishnu himself, he saw without interfering, the destruction of his kinsmen! My son must have himself allowed all this to happen.

sa: मणिः स्यमन्तकश्चैव यः स सत्राजितोऽभवत्। तां कथां श्रावयामास सात्यकिर्मधुसूदनम्॥
en: Then Satyaki informed the destroyer of Madhu as to how Kritavarman had behaved towards Satrajit for taking away from him the celebrated gem Syamantaka.

sa: तं विव्याधशुगैः षड्भिर्धर्मराजस्त्वरनिव॥ कार्मुकं चास्य चिच्छेद क्षुराभ्यां ध्वजमेव च।
en: King Yudhishthira immediately struck him with six arrows. He then cut off the bow and the standard of his antagonist with two razorfaced arrows.

sa: न चैवमिष्यते ब्रह्म शरीराश्रयसम्भवम्। न यत्नसाध्यं तद् ब्रह्म नादिमध्यं न चान्तवत्॥ ।
en: Brahma, however, cannot be acquired in this way, for it depends upon that (Soul) which has the body for its refuge. Without beginning, middle, or end, Brahma cannot be acquired by effort.

sa: न तृतीयोऽस्ति राजेन्द्र सेनयोरुभयोरपि। य एनं शरवर्षाणि वर्षन्तमुदियाद् रथी।॥
en: There is no third car-warrior, O chief among kings, in both these armies who can advance against him while he pours showers of amrows.

sa: तस्य प्रीतः स भगवान् साक्षाद् दर्शनमेयिवान्। दृष्ट्वैव चर्षिः प्रह्वस्तं तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तवैः॥
en: Being gratified with him that exalted deity (Vishnu) appeared before him in his embodied form. As soon as the Rishi saw him, he gratified him in all humility and with many hymns.

sa: यदा त्वेष गुणानेतान् प्राकृतानभिमन्यते। तदा स गुणहान्य तं परमेवानुपश्यति॥
en: When the Individual Soul conquers all qualities born of Nature and which it assumes under mistake, only then does it see the Supreme Soul.

sa: भक्ष्यप्रकारैर्विविधैः फलैश्चापि तथा नृप। चोष्यैश्च विविधै राजन् पेयैश्च बहुविस्तरैः॥ अहतैश्चैव वासोभिर्माल्यैरुच्चावचैरपि। तर्पयामास विप्रेन्द्रान् नानादिग्भ्यः समागतान्॥
en: With the various preparations of meat, with various kinds of other food, with various suckable and drinkable viands, with unused robes and clothes, and with excellent garlands, the king gratified the superior Brahmanas that had assembled there from various directions.

sa: ददर्श वासविर्धीमान् विहीनां वृष्णिपुङ्गवैः। गतश्रियं निरानन्दा पद्मिनी शिशिरे यथा॥
en: Indeed, the son of Vasava, gifted with great intelligence, beheld the city to look even thus, reft as it was of the Vrishni heroes.

sa: ततश्च हतवीरासु क्षत्रियासु पुनः पुनः। द्विजैरुत्पादितं क्षत्रं जामदग्न्यो न्यकृन्तत॥
en: Then the Kshatriyas that were begotten by the Brahmanas upon Kshatriya women who had lost their heroic children, were repeatedly destroyed by Jamadagni's son.

sa: त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम। तस्त चिन्तय यो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, you are capable of compassing this work. Therefore, think as to what course of his (Rāma's) shall remove (my) misery.

sa: पुध्यकरिण्यः शुभास्तत्र सुखस्पर्शा मनोरमाः॥ देवलोकच्युताः सर्वे जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः।
en: Its tanks are charming, delicious and full of pure water. The men born there have all come down from the land of the celestial.

sa: स संस्मरन् द्रोणमहं महाहवे ब्रवीमि सत्यं कुरवो निबोधत। न वा मदन्यः प्रसहेद् रणेऽर्जुनं समागतं मृत्युमिवोग्ररूपिणम्॥
en: Listen to me, O Karna, I tell you the truth, thinking of this Drona in battle that there is none amongst you excepting myself who can withstand the advancing Arjuna the heroes who resembled the most dreadful Regent of Death.

sa: तावुभौ भक्षयित्वा तु स तायः कूर्मकुञ्जरौ। ततः पर्वतकूटाग्रादुत्पपात महाजवः॥
en: The son of Tarkshya (Garuda), having thus eaten the elephant and the tortoise, rose on his wings from the top of that mountain summit.

sa: उत्थानं हि नरेन्द्राणां बृहस्पतिरभाषत। राजधर्मस्य तन्मूलं श्लोकांश्चात्र निबोध मे॥
en: Readiness for action in kings is the root of royal duties. This has been said by Brihaspati. Listen to the verses recited by him.

sa: तस्या यमौ रक्ततलौ पादौ पूजितलक्षणौ। कराभ्यां किणजाताभ्यां शनकैः संववाहतुः॥
en: The twins, taking up her red-soled feet with auspicious marks, began to press them gently with their hands which were scared by the bow-strings.

sa: शतं शतसहस्राणि धर्मिणां तं प्रजेश्वरम्। उपासते महात्मानं रूपयुक्ता मनस्विनः॥
en: Hundreds of thousand of virtuous men of celestials beauty and great wisdom always waits upon and worship the illustrious lord of all created beings.

sa: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः। भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत् तपो मानसमुच्यते॥
en: Serenity of mind, gentleness, taciturnity, self restraint, and purity of disposition, constitute the penance of mind.

sa: रूपेण मत्समो नास्ति कश्चिदित्यस्य दर्शनम्। अधिकश्चाहमेवैक इत्यस्य मनसि स्थितम्॥
en: He, however thought that there was nobody who equalled him in personal beauty. Indeed, he considered himself as superior to all in that matter.

sa: ततस्तत् सर्वमाचष्ट दुर्योधनविचेष्टितम्। भ्रातृणां भीमसेनश्च महाबलपराक्रमः॥
en: Everything about the villainy of Duryodhana was told to his brothers by the greatly powerful Bhima.

sa: सारथिं चास्य दयितमपहस्तेन जनिवान्। धर्मात्मा विदुरस्तेषां पार्थानां प्रददौ मतिम्॥
en: With all his brothers, became very vigilant from that day. And the virtuous minded Vidura gave the sons of Pritha (the Pandavas) good counsels.

sa: दिष्ट्या च कुशली रामो धर्मात्मा सत्यसंगरः। लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजाः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः॥
en: By my good luck, is it all well with the virtuous-souled and truthful Rāma and the highly powerful Lakşmaņa the enhancer of Sumitra's joy?

sa: विमृशन्नेव कालं तं परिचिन्त्य जनार्दनः। मेने प्राप्तं स षट्त्रिंशं वर्षे वै केशिसूदनः॥ पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्ता गान्धारी हतबान्धवा। यदनुव्याजहारार्ता तदिदं समुपागमत्॥
en: The destroyer of Keshi, viz., Janardana, thinking upon the omens that Time showed, understood that the thirty-sixth year had come, and that what Gandhari, burning with grief on account of the death of her sons, and deprived of all her kinsmen, had said was about to take place.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा संरब्धा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशा राममेवाभिदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Having said this in wrath, those fourteen Rākşasas, uplifting their weapons and daggers rushed towards Rāma.

sa: तस्मिन् वने सप्त यहादुमाश्च फलानि सप्तातिथयश्च सप्त। सप्ताश्रमाः सप्त समाधयश्च दीक्षाश्च सप्तैतदरण्यरूपम्।।७।
en: In that forest are seven large trees, seven fruits, and seven guests. There are seven hermitages, (forms of) Yoga concentration, and seven (forms) of initiation. This is a description of that forest.

sa: ततस्ते तामुषित्वा तु रजनीं तत्र तापसाः। हुताग्नयो जप्तजप्याः प्रतस्थुर्मज्जिघांसया॥
en: Then those devotees, staying there for the night, performed their Homa and other ceremonies and went away with the desire of taking my life.

sa: कर्मणां तात पुण्यानां जितानां तपसा स्वयम्। दानानां च महाबाहो फलं प्राप्नुहि पार्थिव॥
en: O mighty-armed one, do you now enjoy. O king the rewards of all your virtuous deeds, of those regions which you have acquired yourself by your penances, and of all your gifts.

sa: पुरा तक्षशिलासंस्थं निवृत्तमपराजितम्। सम्यग्विजयिनं दृष्ट्वा समन्तान्मन्त्रिभिर्वृतम्॥
en: Who had only recently returned victorious from Takshashila. He saw him seated surrounded by his ministers.

sa: अत्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मन् कथितं परमं त्वया। गङ्गावतरणं पुण्यं सागरस्यापि पूरणम्॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, wonderful is the story that you have recited to us, viz; that of Ganga's sacred dissension and the replenishing of the Ocean.

sa: अथोत्तङ्क उपाध्यायमभ्यवादयत्। तमुपाध्यायः प्रत्युवाच वत्सोत्तङ्क स्वागतं ते किं चिरंकृतमिति॥
en: Then did Uttanka salute his preceptor and his preceptor said, “Uttanka, my child, welcome to you. What made you to be so long away?"

sa: ततः कुञ्जान् बहून कृत्वा संनिवृत्ता सरस्वती। ऋषीणां पुण्यतपसां कारुण्याजनमेजय॥
en: Accordingly that best of streams came there, having made sufficient accommodation on her bank for those Rishis, out of compassion for them, O Janamejaya.

sa: यदा च त्वां महाबाहो गन्धर्वैर्हतमोजसा। अमोचयत् पाण्डुसुतः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: When, O mighty-armed hero, that son of Pandu released, with force, you captured by the Gandharvas, that indeed, is indication enough (of his prowess)

sa: अद्यैषां कदनं कृत्वा प्रियं यास्यामि पाण्डवम्॥ अद्य द्रक्ष्यन्ति मे वीर्ये कौरवाः ससुयोधनाः।
en: Today crushing the foe I shall repair to that son of Pandu who is dearly loved my me. Today the Kurus with Suyodhana at their head, will bchold my prowess in battle.

sa: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गा रक्षित्वा पुनरुपाध्यायगृहमेत्य गुरोरग्रत: स्थित्वा नमश्चक्रे॥
en: He assented to his preceptor's words and went to tend the cattle. Having done it he stood before his preceptor and respectfully saluted him.

sa: शुभैः कर्मफलैर्देवि मयैते परिकीर्तिताः। स्वर्गमार्गपरा भूयः किं त्वं श्रोतुमिहेच्छसि॥
en: All these me, O goddess, succeed in ascending to Heaven through the meritorious results of their deeds. What else do you wish to hear?

sa: अव्यक्तं सर्वदेहेषु मर्येषु परमाश्रितम्। योऽनुपश्यति स प्रेत्य कल्पते ब्रह्मभूयसे॥
en: Unmanifest and supreme, it lives in all mortal frames, Guided by the preceptor and the Vedas, he who sees it hereafter becomes Brahma's self.

sa: विवृत्य हि यथाकामं गृहद्वाराणि शेरते। मनुष्या रक्षिता राज्ञा समन्तादकुतोभयाः।॥
en: Again by virtue of royal protection, men can everywhere sleep fearlessly at their ease without shutting their houses and doors with bolts and bars.

sa: ब्राह्मणाश्चतुरो वेदान् नाधीयोरंस्तपस्विनः। विद्यास्नाता व्रतस्नाता यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection Brahmanas would never study the four Vedas or practise austerities or be purified by knowledge and rigid vows.

sa: न वृषा: सम्प्रवर्तेरन् न मध्येरंश्च गर्गराः। घोषाः प्रणाशं गच्छेयुर्यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: The bulls would not know cows and milk jars would not be churned, and men living by rearing kine would be ruined, if the king did not exercise the duty of protection.

sa: ते चैनमनुनेष्यन्ति धृतराष्ट्रं जनाधिपम्। तं च पापसमाचारं सहामात्यं सुयोधनम्॥
en: And they too will lead Dhritarashtra, the lord of men and that Suyodhana of wicked nature with his ministers to do as you bid.

sa: एवमुक्तो नलेनाथ तदा भाङ्गासुरिर्नृपः। आससाद वने राजन् फलवन्तं बिभीतकम्॥
en: O monarch, having been thus addressed by Nala, the royal son of Vangasura came near a tree, called Vibhitaka with fruits, in the wood.

sa: सर्वः सर्वं न जानाति सर्वज्ञो नास्ति कश्चन। नैकत्र परिनिष्ठास्ति ज्ञानस्य पुरुषे क्वचित्॥
en: All men do not know all things; in fact, there is none, who is acquainted with all the branches of knowledge. In one person, the knowledge in its entirety, is not centered.

sa: सर्वं वैनयिकं कृत्वा विनयज्ञो बृहस्पतिम्। दक्षिणानन्तरो भूत्वा प्रणम्य विधिपूर्वकम्॥ विधिं पप्रच्छ राज्यस्य सर्वलोकहिते रतः। प्रजानां सुखमन्विच्छन् धर्मशीलं बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: Always humble, king Vasumanas ever devoted to well-being of all, having observed the proper humilities, and having gone round the great sage and bowed to him duly enquired of the virtuous Brihaspati about the institutes of a kingdom, actuated by the desire of securing the happiness of men.

sa: ततो मुञ्जवटं नाम स्थाणोः स्थानं महात्मनः। उपोष्य रजनीमेकां गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then going to the region of the illustrious Sihanu (Shiva, called Manjabata and living there for one night, one acquires the state of Ganapathya.

sa: यत्र विष्णुकथा दिव्याः श्रुतयश्च सनातनाः। तच्छ्रोतव्यं मनुष्येण परं पदमिहेच्छता॥
en: That in which occurs excellent discourse abyur Vishnu, and the eternal Shrutis should be listened to be men desirous of acquiring the highest end.

sa: सरकस्य तु पूर्वेण नारदस्य महात्मनः। तीर्थं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ अम्बाजन्मेति विश्रुतम्॥
en: O best of the Kurus, in the east of Saraka is the sacred Tirtha of the illustrious Narada, known by the name of Ambajanma.

sa: शालिहोत्रस्य तीर्थे च शालिसूर्ये यथाविधि। स्नात्वा नरवरश्रेष्ठ गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing according to the ordinance in the Shalisurya of Shalihotra, O king of kings, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: द्रोणेन निहताः शूराः शेरते रुचिराङ्गदाः। धृष्टद्युम्नसुताः सर्वे शिशवो हेममालिनः॥
en: arrows There, the brave sons of Dhrishtadyurnna, young in age, and bedecked with garlands of gold and beautiful Angadas, are lying, killed by Drona.

sa: उत्तमं सर्वतीर्थानां यस्त्यजेदात्मनस्तनुम्। पृथूदके जप्यपरो नैव श्वो मरणं तपेत्॥
en: He, who by the recitation of prayers casts off his body at Prithadaka which is the best of all the Tirthas, becomes an immortal.

sa: यत्र योगेश्वरः स्थाणुः स्वयमेव वृषध्वजः। तमर्चयित्वा देवेशं गमनादेव सिध्यति॥
en: There the lord of Yoga, Vrishdhvaja, Sthanu himself is always is present. Going there he who worships the lord of the celestials obtains success.

sa: अनेकैरिषुसङ्घातैरन्तरिक्षे ववर्ष ह।
en: And he discharged at the firmament innumerable darts.

sa: पावनं तीर्थमासाद्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, going to the Tirtha, called Pavana and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: तत एनं समुत्क्षिप्य सहसा विनतासुतः। उत्पपात नभस्तूर्णं तत्र चैनममुञ्चत॥
en: All on a sudden taking the king up, the son of Vinata soared into the sky and there released the king from his beaks.

sa: त्रेताग्नयोऽपि दीप्यन्ते धूमो ह्येष प्रदृश्यते। वेष्टयन्निव वृक्षाग्रान् कपोताङ्गारुणो घनः॥
en: Here burneth the fire Tretā; and the smoke and cloud sable like to the wings of a pigeon envelope the tops of the trees.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। जपहोमसमायुक्तं स्वां रक्षन्तं महाचमूम्॥
en: When you will see Yudhishthira the son of Kunti in battle, endued with Japa and Homa and engaged in protecting his own vast army.

sa: स चापि शक्रस्त्रिदिवालयं तदा प्रीतो ययौ राघवकार्यसिद्धये। आमन्त्र्य सीतां स ततो महात्मा जगाम निद्रासहितः स्वमालयम्॥
en: And Sakra also for bringing about the success of Rāghava's work, with a pleased mind, went to the abode of celestials. And greeting Sītā again and again, that high-souled celestial, in company with sleep went back to his own abode.

sa: युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो भीमसेन परंतप। अर्जुनाश्विसुतौ वीरौ निबोधत वचो मम॥
en: O mighty-armed Yudhishthira, O Bhimasena who are a scorcher of enemies, O Arjuna, and O twines of great courage, listen to what I say!

sa: गमनाय मतिं चक्रे भ्रातरशास्य ते तदा। ततः स राजा कौरव्यो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ उत्सृज्याभरणान्यङ्गाज्जगृहे वल्कलान्युत। भीमार्जुनयमाश्चैव द्रौपदी च यशस्विनी॥ तथैव जगृहु: सर्वे वल्कलानि नराधिप। विधिवत् कारयित्वेष्टिं नैष्ठिकी भरतर्षभ॥ समुत्सृज्याप्सु सर्वेऽग्नीन् प्रतस्थुर्नरपुङ्गवाः। तत: प्ररुरुदुः सर्वाः स्त्रियो दृष्ट्वा नरोत्तमान्॥
en: He them made up his mind he leave the world. His brothers also formed the same resolution. Then Dharma's son Yudhishthira, the king of the Kurus, renouncing his ornaments, wore barks of trees Bhima and Arjuna and the twines, and the illustrious Draupadi similarly clad them salves in barks of trees, O sing. Having caused the preliminary rites of religion, O chief of Bharata's race which to bless them in the accomplishment of their design, those foremost of men renounced their sacred fires to the water. Seeing the preaches in that guise the ladies wept aloud.

sa: वृद्धश्चैवाल्पपुत्रश्च वेदेहीमनुचिन्तयन्। सोऽपि शोकसमाविष्टो नूनं त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥ साहमचैव दिष्टान्तं गमिष्यामि पतिव्रता। इदं शरीरमालिङ्गय प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्॥
en: Old and having an only daughter, he revolving in his mind thoughts of Vaidehi, shall, smitten with grief, surely renounce his life. I ever faithful to my lord will die this very day, embracing this body; I will enter fire.

sa: ईदृशश्च महादेवो भूयांश्च भगवानजः। न हि सर्वे मया शक्या वक्तुं भगवतो गुणाः॥
en: Such is the Lord Mahadeva, that Divinity without birth and that possessor of the six illustrious qualities the Bhagas. It is beyond my power to enumerate all the qualities of that lord.

sa: भूमिपानां च शुश्रूषा कर्तव्या सर्वदस्युभिः। वेदधर्मक्रियाश्चैव तेषां धर्मो विधीयते॥
en: All the robber tribes should also serve their kings. The duties and rites laid down in the Vedas should also be followed by them.

sa: त्वया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥ भगवन् भूतभव्येश लोकनाथ जगत्पते। प्रसादं कुरु शक्रस्य त्वया क्रोधार्दितस्य वै॥
en: Yourself pervade the whole universe with its mobile and immobile creatures. O lord of the past and the future, O lord of the Lokas, O master of the universe, be propitious on Shakra afflicted as he is with your wrath.

sa: रुरोरपि सुतो जज्ञे शुनको वेदपारगः। प्रमद्वरायां धर्मात्मा तव पूर्वपितामहः॥
en: Ruru had a son by his wife Pramadvara. O Shaunaka, he was your grandfather; he was very virtuous and greatly learned in the Vedas.

sa: कुञ्जरेणेव मत्तेन वीर संग्राममूर्धनि। दुर्योधनशिरो दिष्ट्या पादेन मृदितं त्वया॥
en: By good luck, you have, O hero, like an infuriate elephant, crushed with your foot the head of Duryodhana on the field of battle!

sa: श्वोभूते धृतराष्ट्रस्य समीपं प्राप्य पाण्डव। यतिष्ये प्रशमं कर्तुं युष्मदर्थमहापयन्॥
en: At the dawn of day, going near Dhritarashtra, O son of Pandu, shall I try to effect peace without a sacrifice of your interests.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच हतस्त्वमसि गान्धारे सभ्रातृसुतबान्धवः॥ सगणः ससुहचैव पापं मार्गमनुष्ठितः।
en: Vasudeva said You, O son of Gandhari, have been killed with your brothers, sons, kinsmen, friends, and followers, for the sinful path you followed.

sa: अभाग्यया मया नूनं वियुक्ताः सहचारिणः। तेन मे विप्रयोगोऽयमुपपन्नस्त्वया सह॥
en: Unfortunate am I! some loving couple had no doubt been separated by me in my former life. From this I am separated from you.

sa: ततो मेघा रथे तस्मिंस्तडित्त्वन्तो महाबलाः। अग्रतो वायुचपला नेदुः परमनिःस्वनाः॥
en: (And he having) ascended the car, the huge clouds, with lightening, being driven by winds, began to emit forth loud mutterings before the chariot.

sa: तथैवायं गदापाणिर्धार्तराष्ट्रो गतकमः। न शक्यो धर्मतो हन्तुं कालेनापीह दण्डिना॥
en: Likewise, the son of Diritarashtra, when armed with the mace, could not be killed in fair fight by Yama himself, armed with his bludgeon.

sa: प्रीत्यर्थं तव चैतन्मे स्वर्गसंदर्शनं कृतम्। यत् वे वनेऽस्मिन् नृपते दृष्टं दिव्यं निदर्शनम्॥
en: For pleasing you and your qucen I made you to have a glimpse of Heaven, All those things which you have seen in these woods, O king, are a foretaste of Heaven.

sa: अन्तर्हितः पुनश्चास्मि पुनरेव च ते गृहे। योगमास्थाय संसुप्तो दिवसानेकविंशतिम्॥
en: I then disappeared, and again showed myself in the room of your palace, and once more following Yoga slept for one and twenty days.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच ब्रूहि केशव तत्वेन त्वमध्यात्ममनिन्दितम्। श्रुत्वा श्रेयोऽभिधास्यामि शापं वा ते जनार्दन॥
en: Utanka said Do you, O Keshava, tell ine that faultless spiritual science. Having heard your discourse I shall ordain what is for your good or imprecate a curse to you O Janardana!

sa: एवं सर्वे समस्तैस्ते राजानः सुकृतैस्तदा। ययाति स्वर्गतो भ्रष्टं तारयामासुरञ्जसा॥
en: By this means did all those kings by their good deeds easily save Yayati, who had been turned out from heaven, at that time.

sa: विललाप च यत् कृष्ण सभामध्ये समेयुषी। न तन्मर्षयते कृष्णो न राज्यहरणं तथा॥
en: Formerly it was heard by us that the two Krishnas are of the same mind and are firmly attached to each other. Today, O lord, we have seen it with our eyes.

sa: ततो वसुमनाः पूर्वमुच्चैरुच्चारयन् वचः। ख्यातो दानपतिलेकि व्याजहार नृपं तदा॥
en: Then did Vasumanas, renowned in this world as the foremost among givers, first uttering these words in a loud voice said to the king.

sa: किं ते जनक्षयेणेह कृतेन भरतर्षभ। यस्मिञ्जिते जितं तत् स्यात् पुमानेकः स दृश्यताम्॥५२
en: Of what advantage will a massacre of men be to you, O best among the Bharatas. Show me the man who will defeat the one whose defeat will mean victory to you,

sa: लक्ष्मणश्चात्र धर्मात्मा मातङ्गानामिवर्षभः। यस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य न जीवेदपि वासवः॥
en: Here also is the virtuous Lakşmaņa, like to the foremost of elephants, coming in the way of whose shafts, even Vasava does not live.

sa: वायुः सर्वात्मको राजन् प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति। अशुभं मार्गमास्थाय न धर्मं प्रत्यवेक्षते॥
en: O king, that life of all, the Air, was desirous of overcoming us, having recourse to an improper way; nor did he regard morality.

sa: वेदानधीत्य धर्मेण राजशास्त्राणि चानघ । संतानादीनि कर्माणि कृत्वा सोमं निषेव्य च॥ पालयित्वा प्रजाः सर्वा धर्मेण वदतां वरः। राजसूयाश्वमेधादीन् मखानन्यांस्तथैव च॥ आनयित्वा यथापाठं विप्रेभ्यो दत्तदक्षिणः। संग्रामे विजयं प्राप्य तथाल्पं यदि वा बहु॥ स्थापयित्वा प्रजापालं पुत्रं राज्ये च पाण्डव। अन्यगोत्रं प्रशस्तं वा क्षत्रियं क्षत्रियर्षभ॥ अर्चयित्वा पितृन् सम्यक् पितृयज्ञैर्यथाविधि। देवान् यज्ञैर्ऋषीन् वेदैरर्चयित्वा तु यत्नतः॥ अन्तकाले च सम्प्राप्ते य इच्छेदाश्रमान्तरम्। सोऽनुपूर्व्याश्रमान् राजन्
en: Having studied the Vedas duly and the works describing the duties of kings, O sinless one, having procreated children and performed similar other acts, having drunk the Soma and governed and protected all his subjects piously, O foremost of speakers, having celebrated a Rajasuya, the horse sacrifice, and other great sacrifices, having invited learned Brahmanas for reciting the scriptures and made presents to them according to their merits, having obtained victories small or great in battle, having placed on his throne his own begotten son or some Kshatriya of good birth for the protection of his subjects, having worshipped the departed manes by performing with due rites the sacrifice prescribed for honouring them, having attentively adored the gods by performing sacrifices and the Rishis b

sa: भ्रातरश्च महेष्वासास्त्रिदशा इव वासवम्। हयानन्ये समारुह्य गजानन्ये च भारत॥
en: Numerous fierce bowmen of worldwide fame with bows in hand, as also his brothers all mighty bowmen, followed him like the celestial following Vasava.

sa: आगमिष्ये ततः क्षिप्रं त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम्। अपक्रान्ते ततो भीष्मे प्रहरिष्यसि संयुगे॥
en: “Having persuaded that foremost of men, Bhishma to withdraw himself from the battle, I shall soon come back to you, O redresser of foes.

sa: सहिताश्चाभ्यधावन्त ततस्ते मानवा दुतम्॥ कृताञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा नम इत्येव वादिनः।
en: The denizens in a body, ran towards that light, with hands joined in reverential attitude, full of joy, and uttering the one word Salutation.

sa: अहं तदाशां धक्ष्यामि पितुस्तस्याश्च या तव। अभिषेकविघातेन पुत्रराज्याय वर्तते॥
en: Burn shall I down that hope of my father and Kaikeyi that they want to place Bharata on the throne by hindering your installation.

sa: न किलातप्ततपसा शक्यते द्रष्टुमञ्जसा। ततः पुनर्वर्षशतं तप्त्वा तात्कालिकं महत्॥ व्रतावसाने च शुभान् नरान् ददृशिरे वयम्।
en: Under the influence of this idea we once more began to practise some severe austerities, suited to the time and place, for a hundred years. Upon the termination of our vows, we saw a number of men of auspicious marks.

sa: अथ रामो महातेजा विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्॥ पप्रच्छ मुनिशार्दूलं कौतूहलसमन्वितम्। भगवन् को न्वयं देशः समृद्धवनशोभितः॥ श्रोतुमिच्छामि भद्रं ते वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः।
en: Then Rama of exceeding energy, influenced by curiosity, asked that foremost of ascetics, Viśvāmitra, having asceticism for his wealth, saying, 'O worshipful one, what country is this, graced with luxuriant woods? I am desirous of hearing this Good betide you, it behove you to tell me this truly.

sa: विदुला नाम राजन्या जगहें पुत्रमौरसम्। निर्जितं सिन्धुराजेन शयानं दीनचेतसम्॥
en: The princess Vidula thus censured her own son who, being defeated by the king of the Sindhus, was lying down with a sorrowful heart.

sa: ब्राह्मणेष्वेव मेधावी बुद्धिपर्येषणं चरेत्। अलब्धस्य च लाभाय लब्धस्य परिवृद्धये॥
en: An intelligent man, for acquiring what he has not got and for multiplying what he has got, should take the advice of the Brahmanas.

sa: द्वयोरेकतरे बुद्धिः क्रियतामद्य पुष्कर। कैतवेनाक्षवत्यां तु युद्धे वा नाम्यतांधनुः॥
en: O Pushkara, do you choose today one of these two; that is, do you either game at dice or bend the bow in battle.

sa: दिष्ट्या च ध्रियसे राजन् सदारोऽद्य महाभुज। धनेनानेन वै भैमी जितेन समलंकृता।॥ देवनेन मम मामुपस्थास्यति व्यक्तं दिवि शक्रमिवाप्सराः। नित्यशो हि स्मरामि त्वां प्रतीक्षेऽपि च नैषध॥
en: O monarch, O mighty-armed one, that you are still living with your wife, is owing to your good luck. Indeed, the daughter of king Bhima, decked in ornaments, will attend me with all the wealth, that I will gain from you, even as the Apsaras wait upon Shakra in heaven. O prince of the Nishadhas, do I, therefore, recollect you and expect you always.

sa: दमयन्त्यैवमुक्ता सा जगामाथ च केशिनी॥ निशम्याथ हयज्ञस्य लिङ्गानि पुनरागमत्।
en: Thus spoken by Damayanti, Keshini went away. Having learnt the behaviours of that person, who was versed in the knowledge of horses, Keshini returned.

sa: जित्वा रिपुगणांश्चैव पारयत्वर्जुनो व्रतम्। श्वोऽहत्वा सिन्धुराजं वै धूमकेतुं प्रवेक्ष्यति॥
en: Let Arjuna fulfill his vow and vanquish his enemies. If tomorrow he fails to slay the Sindhu king, he will enter the blazing fire.

sa: अवैमि चाहं नृपते न तु मां त्यक्तुमर्हसि। चेतसा त्वपकृष्टेन मां त्यजेथा महीपते।॥
en: O protector of your subjects! I know also that you cannot leave me. But, O ruler of the earth! you may renounce me, as your mind (reason) is spoiled (distracted) by Kali.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रोऽपि राजेन्द्र संवृतः सर्वकौरवैः। हर्षेण महता युक्तो विदुरं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: O king of kings that foremost of kings, Dhritarashtra, surrounded by all the Kurus felt the greatest joy and he thus spoke to Vidura.,

sa: अथ श्येनो राजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon the hawk spoke Thus to the king.

sa: यस्य मण्डलमध्यस्थो महात्मा परमत्विषा। दीप्तः समीक्षते लोकान् किमाश्चर्यमतः परम्॥
en: What can be more wonderful than this the Supreme Soul, from within the solar disc, himself bathed in burning effulgence, looks upon the universe?

sa: सुमन्त्रस्त्वपि शत्रुघ्नमदूरादन्वपद्यत। रामदर्शनजस्तों भरतस्येव तस्य च॥
en: And eager to see Rāma even like Bharata himself, Sumantra followed Bharata at a short distance.

sa: पतत्त्रीणां च गरुडमिन्द्रत्वेनाभ्यषिञ्चत। तस्यैतत्कर्म सुमहच्छ्रयतां भृगुनन्दन॥
en: Garuda became the king of the birds. O descendent of Bhrigu, listen to his great deeds.

sa: एवमुक्ताः कश्यपेन वालखिल्यास्तपोधनाः। प्रत्यूचुरभिसंपूज्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं प्रजापतिम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Kashyapa, the Valakhilya Rishis saluted the great Prajapati and spoke thus,

sa: अहस्सु विहरानेन यथाकामं मनोजवा। अयं त्वानयितव्यस्ते भीमसेनः सदा निशि॥
en: O lady of mind like speed, sport with him at pleasure during the day. You must always bring Bhimasena back every night. can never

sa: याश्च्यवन्तेऽम्बरात् ताराः पुण्यशेषसमावृताः। इमास्ताः संगताः कृत्स्ना इति मेने हरिस्तदा॥
en: “Those stars that drop from the firmament on their virtue deteriorating, have assembled here in a body," thus thought the monkey at that time.

sa: नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात् किंचिद् दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात्॥ यथा सर्वेषु देवेषु वरिष्ठो भगवाञ्छिवः।
en: Indeed, as Shiva is the foremost of all the gods, so is this hymn, consonant with the Shrutis, is the foremost of all hymns.

sa: भवाभवौ त्वभिजानन् गरीयो ज्ञानाच्छ्रेयो न तु करोमि। आशासु धासु परासु कुर्वन् यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि॥
en: Knowing what is existence and what liberation, and understanding also that the latter is superior to the former, I do not, however, try to attain to it. Doing virtuous and sinful acts I go on as He moves me on.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षा महाबलाः॥ बलमुद्योजयामासुस्तस्मिनाक्षसमन्दिरे।
en: Hearing his speech, the highly powerful leaders arrayed the army in that abode of the Raksasa.

sa: अथवा धर्मराज्ञाहमनुज्ञाता महाभुज। भक्षयिष्ये विषं घोरं प्रवेक्ष्ये वा हुताशनम्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, with the permission of king Yudhishthira the just. I shall swallow some dreadful poison or cast myself on the burning fire.

sa: इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन स बालो भरतर्षभ। शनैः शनैर्महाराज प्रास्पन्दत सचेतनः॥
en: After these words uttered by Vasudeva, that child, O foremost one of Bharata's family, became animal and began gradually to move, O king. were

sa: पूर्वरात्रे तु तत्रासौ भूत्वा ध्यानपरायणः॥ मध्यरात्रे यथान्यायं निद्रामाहारयत् प्रभुः।
en: In the first part of the night, he gave himself of Yoga. The powerful ascetic, passed the middle part of the night in sleep.

sa: आत्मनः सदृशः शौर्याद् बलरूपसमन्वितः। स एव भगवान् क्रोधः प्रतिरूपसमन्वितः॥
en: name In energy, strength, and form, he took after Maheshvara himself who had created him. Indeed, he was the living embodiment of (Mahadeva's) anger.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषिः कोपसमन्वितः। प्रत्युवाच ततः पत्नी प्रद्वेषीं ससुतां तदा॥
en: Bhishma said: Having heard her words, the Rishi became angry and he said to his wife Pradveshi and her sons "Take me to the Kshatriyas (kings) and you will then be rich."

sa: ते बद्धाः कालपाशेन संवर्तेन विदारिताः। क्षणेनाभिहतास्तेन तिस्त्र: कोट्यो महात्मना॥
en: Having bound them all with the noose of death and sundered them with Sangharata, Bharata despatched all the Gandharvas to the abode of death.

sa: ते तत्र नियताः कालं कंचिदूषुर्नरर्षभाः। मात्रा सहैकचक्रायां ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने॥
en: They those best of men, with their mother lived there for some time in the house of a Brahmana, in temperance and in abstinence.

sa: गङ्गोवाच ममाप्येवं मतं देवा यथा मां वदतानघाः। प्रियं तस्य करिष्यामि युष्माकं चैतदीप्सितम्॥
en: Ganga said: O celestials, this is also my wish which you sinless ones have expressed. I shall do the favourite works of that king. It is also your wish as just expressed.

sa: अनुज्येष्ठं तु ते तत्र युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। चक्रुरस्त्रं महावीर्याः कुमाराः परमाद्भुतम्॥
en: With Yudhisthira, at their head, the greatly heroic princes, in the order of their age, began to show wonderful skill in their arms. a

sa: सौतिरुवाच गतमात्रं तु भर्तारं जरत्कारुरवेदयत्। भ्रातुः सकाशमागत्य याथातथ्यं तपोधन॥
en: Sauti said: O ascetic Rishi, as soon as her husband was gone, Jaratkaru went to her brother and told him all that had happened.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इति श्रुत्वा पुलोमाया भृगुः परममन्युमान्। शशापाग्निमतिक्रुद्धः सर्वभक्षो भविष्यसि॥
en: Sauti said: Having heard this from Puloma Bhrigu became exceedingly angry and out of anger he cursed Agni, saying, “Be an all devouring (element).

sa: ततः सस्मार हेरम्बं व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः। स्मृतमात्रो गणेशानो भक्तचिन्तितपूरकः॥ तत्राजगाम विघ्नेशो वेदव्यासो यतः स्थितः। पूजितश्चोपविष्टश्च व्यासेनोक्तस्तदाऽनघ॥
en: Then Vyasa remembered Ganesha in his mind. As soon as he was thought of the expeller of obstacles, Ganesha, who is always ready to fulfil the desire of his worshippers, came at once to the place where Vyasa was seated.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां गवां चैव माहात्म्यं यत्र कीर्त्यते। सर्वश्रुतिसमूहोऽयं श्रोतव्यो धर्मबुद्धिभिः॥
en: And the greatness of Brahmanas and kine. It is a collection of all Shrutis and a work worthy to be heard by virtuous-minded men.

sa: कस्य स्यादीदृशो भाव आहारो देवसंमत। आश्चर्य वर्तते सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। नाहमौपयिकं मन्ये तव भक्ष्यमिमं शवम्॥
en: O you adored of the immortals, persons like you should not take such meals. O gentle one, I have been stricken with great curiosity and wish to hear all. Thine living upon dead body does not appear agreeable to me.

sa: कच्चित्तव गृहेऽन्नानि स्वादून्यश्नन्ति वै द्विजाः। गुणवन्ति गुणोपेतास्तवाध्यक्षं सदक्षिणम्॥ ॥
en: Are the accomplished Brahmanas entertained in your presence with delicious and nutritive food in your house? Do they get (proper) Dakshinas after the feast?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उषित्वा खाण्डवप्रस्थे सुखवासं जनार्दनः। पाथैः प्रीतिसमायुक्तैः पूजनार्दोऽभिपूजितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Janardana, (Krishna) who deserved the worship of all, lived for sometime Khandavaprastha, worshipped with love and affection by the sons of Pritha.

sa: पितर ऊचुः यायावरा नाम वयमृषयः संशितव्रताः। संतानप्रक्षयाब्रह्मन्नधो गच्छाम मेदिनीम्॥
en: The Ancestors said : We are Rishis of austere penances, called Yayavaras. We are sinking down into the earth for want of an offspring.

sa: मद्वाक्यसमकालं ते मोक्तव्योऽत्र भवेच्छरः। तिष्ठ तावन्मुहूर्तकम्॥ वितत्य कार्मुकं पुत्र
en: "You must shoot the aim as soon as I shall give order, O son, stand here for a moment with your bow and arrow."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो धनंजयं द्रोण: स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत। त्वयेदानी प्रहर्तव्यमेतल्लक्ष्यं विलोक्यताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Drona smilingly, called Dhananjaya and said to him, “ It is to be shot by you. Turn your eyes to it.

sa: भविष्यति च धर्मात्मा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। पितुः प्रियहिते युक्तः स्त्रीभोगान् वर्जयिष्यति॥
en: "He will be virtuous-minded and learned in all Shastras. He will be very obedient to his father and abstain from the pleasure of women."

sa: ममापि चेद् भवेदेवमीश्वरस्य सतो महत्। उपेक्षमाणस्य पुनर्लोकानां किल्बिषाद् भयम्॥
en: Capable as I am of punishing this crime, if I abstain from doing it, men will once more have to undergo a similar persecution.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मन्दपालोऽपि कौरव्य चिन्तयामास पुत्रकान्। उक्त्वापि च स तिग्मांशुं नैव शर्माधिगच्छति॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Kuru, Mandapala became anxious for his sons. Although he had spoken of them to the deity of fearful rays (Agni), his mind was not in peace.

sa: तस्मिन् नृपतिशार्दूले प्रविष्टे नगरं पुनः। प्रववर्ष सहस्राक्षः सस्यानि जनयन् प्रभुः॥ ततः सराष्ट्र मुमेदे तत् पुरं परया मुदा। तेन पार्थिवमुख्येन भावितं भावितात्मना॥
en: When that best of kings again entered his capital, the state of things became as before, the god of one thousand years, the slayer of Asuras, poured rain in abundance; and he caused corn to grow. Thus being revived by that virtuous-minded and that best of kings (Samvarana), the capital and the country became exceedingly glad.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरं पूर्वमुवाचाङ्गिरसां वरः। संधत्स्व बाणं दुर्घष मद्वाक्यान्ते विमुञ्च तम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The best of the descendant of Angirasa (Drona) first spoke to Yudhisthira thus, "O invincible one, aim with your arrow and shoot (the bird) as soon as I order.”

sa: पुरा किल महाबाहो देवासुरसमागमे। वृत्रो नाम महानासी तेयो लोकसंमतः।।।।
en: O you having long arms, formerly, during the war between gods and demons there flourished a highly honoured Asura under the name of Vſtra.

sa: प्रसीद वशगोऽहं ते भक्तं मां भज भाविनि। दृष्ट्वैव त्वां वरारोहे मन्मथो भृशमङ्गने॥
en: O beautiful maiden, be merciful, I am your obedient (slave), (I am) your adorer; accept me. O beautiful lady, O large-eyed maiden, as soon as I saw you, he god of love,

sa: भक्तं मामसितापाङ्गिन परित्यक्तुमर्हसि। त्वं हि मां प्रीतियोगेन त्रातुमर्हसि भाविनि॥
en: O black eyed lady, you should not abandon me. O handsome lady, you should relieve me from such affliction by giving me your love.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ते तक्षकसमादिष्टास्तथा चक्रुर्भुजंगमाः। उपनिन्युस्तथा राज्ञे दर्भानापः फलानि च॥
en: Sauti said: The snakes, commanded by Takshaka, did (as they were ordered to do) They took to the king, Kusha grass, water and fruits.

sa: दुर्योधनस्यापि तदा कर्णमासाद्य पार्थिवा भयमर्जुनसंजातं क्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत॥
en: O king, Duryodhana, having obtained Karna, banished his fears arising out of Arjuna)'s proficiency in arms.

sa: ततस्तु कृतसंनाहा यज्ञसेनसहोदराः। शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तः प्रणेदुः सर्व एव ते॥
en: The king Yajnasena (Drupada) was well armed, but he was assailed by them (Kurus) with a shower of arrows, all uttering their war cry.

sa: एषां पराक्रमस्यान्ते वयं कुर्याम साहसम्। एतैरशक्यः पाञ्चालो ग्रहीतुं रणमूर्धनि॥
en: “We shall display our power when they would finish theirs. The are not capable of killing the king of the Panchalas in the battle."

sa: तदभ्यासकृतं मत्वा रात्रावपि स पाण्डवः। योग्यां चक्रे महाबाहुर्धनुषा पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: Thinking this to be the result of the force of habit, the mighty armed son of Pandu practiced with his bow in the night.

sa: इदं मे व्रतमादत्स्व सत्यं सत्यवतां वर। नैव जातो न वाजात ईदृशं वक्तुमुत्सहेत्॥
en: O foremost of truthful men, listen to the vow I take today. There is none born or will be born who will have the courage to take to take such a vow.

sa: देवराजे गते राजन् प्रहृष्टौ केशवार्जुनौ॥ निर्विशङ्कं वनं वीरौ दाहयामासतुस्तदा।
en: O king, when Indra had gone away Keshava and Arjuna became exceedingly glad. Those two heroes then fearlessly assisted Agni to consume that forest.

sa: गत्वा च शिविरद्वार दुर्दृशं तत्र राक्षसम्। घोररूपमपश्यत्स दिवमावृत्य धिष्ठितम्॥
en: Going to the gate of the camp, he saw a fearful Rakshasa, his head reaching to the very skies, guarding the door. an to

sa: सर्वज्ञोऽपि गणेशो यत् क्षणमास्ते विचारयन्। तावच्चकार व्यासोऽपि श्लोकानन्यान्बहूनपि॥ ८३।
en: Even self-knowing Ganesha had to take time to think (over their meaning), and during that time, Vyasa continued to compose other Verses great numbers.

sa: समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते निर्भयो विगतज्वरः। फलमूलाशनो वीर निवसेह यथासुखम्॥
en: You have no fear now. Therefore, O hero, being consoled and renouncing all anxiety do you live here happily living upon fruits and roots.

sa: द्वादशैवादितेः पुत्राः शक्रमुख्या नराधिप। तेषामवरजो विष्णुर्यत्र लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥ ४१॥
en: O king, the sons of Aditi were twelve with Indra at their head. The youngest of them was Vishnu, upon whom the worlds depend.

sa: द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि क्षमावन्तौ मनीषिणौ। बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मवादिनी॥
en: And Devala had two sons, both greatly wise and forgiving, The sister of Brihaspati, the first of women, the utterer of the sacred truth.

sa: स च तान् प्रतिविव्याध द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां पराक्रमन्। तद् युद्धमासीत् तुमुलं घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥ पश्यतां लोकवीराणां शरशक्तिसमाकुलम्। स धनूंषि ध्वजाग्राणि वर्माणि च शिरांसि च॥ चिच्छेद समरे भीष्मः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। तस्याति पुरुषानन्याँल्लाघवं रथचारिणः॥ रक्षणं चात्मनः संख्ये शत्रवोऽप्यभ्यपूजयन्। तान् विनिर्जित्य तु रणे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ कन्याभिः सहितः प्रायाद् भारतो भारतान् प्रति। ततस्तं पृष्ठतो राजञ्छाल्वराजो महारथः॥ अभ्यगच्छदमेयात्मा भीष्मं शान्तनवं रणे। वारणं जघने भिन्दन् दन्ताभ्यामपरो यथा॥ वासित
en: But he stopped the attacking kings each with two arrows. The battle became so fierce with the dense shower of arrows that it looked like the battle between the Devas and the Danavas. And even brave men were struck with fear to look at it. (Bhishma) cut off by his arrows flag staffs, armours and human heads by hundreds and thousands on the field of battle. Such was his prowess and extraordinary lightness of hand, such was the skill with which he protected himself, that the fighting car-warriors, though his enemies, loudly applauded him. That foremost of all experts in arms (Bhishma), having defeated all the kings in battle and having taken the maidens with him, went towards the capital of the Bharatas. O king, then the great car-warrior king, Shalva, challenged from behind the son of Shanta

sa: तक्षकस्तु स नागेन्द्रः पुरंदरनिवेशनम्। गतः श्रुत्वैव राजानं दीक्षितं जनमेजयम्॥
en: In the meanwhile, as soon as Takshaka heard that Janamejaya had been installed in the sacrifice, he, the king of snakes, went to Indra.

sa: कुमारा ऊचुः मुद्रिकामपि विप्रर्षे शीघ्रमेतां समुद्धर।
en: The princes said : "O best of the twice born, raise up the ring without delay.

sa: विनान्योन्यं न भुञ्जाते विनान्योन्यं न जल्पतः। अन्योन्यस्य प्रियकरावन्योन्यस्य प्रियंवदौ॥
en: Each speaking and doing what was agreeable to each other, the brothers never ate unless they were together and never went anywhere unless together.

sa: अतः परं कर्णपर्वं प्रोच्यते परमाद्भुतम्। सारथ्ये विनियोगश्च मद्रराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: Then comes the most wonderful Parva named Karna. In it is described the appointment of king of the Madra as the charioteer (of Karna).

sa: ततस्ते यत्नमातिष्ठन् वीटामुद्धर्तुमादृताः। न च ते प्रत्यपद्यन्त कर्म वीटोपलब्धये॥
en: Thereupon, they tried their utmost to recover the ball (from the well). But with all their efforts they could not get up the ball.

sa: प्रागेवानागते काले तस्मात्त्वं मय्यजायथाः। अयं स काल: संप्राप्तो भयान्नस्त्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: As the result of that marriage, you were born of me. That time has now come. You should now protect us from this danger.

sa: तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारी निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां तदा। समुत्सुकौ तौ सुखमूषतुर्निशां यथाश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम्॥
en: Like to the two Asvins following the moral precepts of Sukra, the two princes, placing those wonderful counsels of Vālmiki in their minds, spent the night with a heart stricken with curiosity.

sa: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ। यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्व सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम्॥
en: There upon the night being over, having bathed and performed the Homa; both Lava and Kusa, in consonance with Rsi's command, began the song.

sa: विव्याध लक्ष्यं निपपात तच्च छिद्रेण भूमौ सहसातिविद्धम्। ततोऽन्तरिक्षे च बभूव नादः समाजमध्ये च महान् निनादः॥
en: Shot the mark and caused it to come down on the ground through the orifice the machinery above over which it had been placed. Thereupon rose a great uproar in the sky and also a great clamour in the arena.

sa: तत: कुमारं सा देवी प्राप्तकालमजीजनत्। पाण्डु लक्षणसम्पन्नं दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया॥
en: The lady (Ambalika) gave birth to a son in due time. He was of pale complexion, very effulgent and endued with all auspicious marks.

sa: दग्धपक्षाक्षिचरणा विचेष्टन्तो महीतले। तत्र तत्र स्म दृश्यन्ते विनश्यन्तः शरीरिणः॥
en: Some were seen rolling on the ground with their wings, eyes and feet scorched and burnt. They were soon after found to be dead.

sa: अथाभ्यगच्छद् भरतान् वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः। तमागतं प्रयत्नेन प्रत्युद्गम्याभिवाद्य च॥ अध्यमभ्याहरंस्तस्मै ते सर्वे भारतास्तदा। निवेद्य सर्वमृषये सत्कारेण सुवर्चसे॥ तमासने चोपविष्टं राजा ववे स्वयं तदा। पुरोहितो भवान् नोऽस्तु राज्याय प्रयतेमहि॥
en: (And when they were living there), the illustrious Rishi Vasistha one day came to those exiled Bharatas. On his approach, they went out and duly worshipped him. All the Bharatas offered him Arghya and entertaining him with reverence, they told every thing to the great Rishi. When he was seated on his seat, the king himself addressed him thus, "O illustrious man, be our priest. We shall try to regain our kingdom."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भीमसेनस्तदा राजन्नर्जुनेन निवारितः। अतृप्तो युद्धधर्मेषु न्यवर्तत महाबलः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king thus prevented by Arjuna, the greatly strong Bhima, though unsatiated with the battle, refrained from the act of slaughter.

sa: ततोऽधिजग्मुः सर्वे ते धनुर्वेदं महारथाः। धृतराष्ट्रात्मजाश्चैव पाण्डवाः सह यादवैः॥ वृष्णयश्च नृपाश्चान्ये नानादेशसमागताः।
en: The great car warriors, the sons of Dhritarashtra, the Pandavas, the Yadavas and the Vrishni and many other princes came to him and received from him lessons in the science of arms.

sa: स तथान्तर्गतेनैव शूलेन व्यतरन्मुनिः। तेनातितपसा लोकान् विजिग्ये दुर्लभान् परैः॥
en: The Rishi in that state with Shula practised the austerest penances and he thus conquered by his asceticism many regions difficult to be obtained.

sa: पूरोवर्चनमाज्ञाय नाहुषः परया मुदा। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे जरां संक्रामयच्च ताम्॥
en: Hearing those words of Puru Yayāti was highly pleased and attained to an excess of delight and then transferred his won decrepitude to him.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कृपस्यापि मम ब्रह्मन् सम्भवं वक्तुमर्हसि। शरस्तम्बात् कथं जज्ञे कथं वास्त्राण्यवाप्तवान्॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, you should relate to me the account of the birth of Kripa. How did he spring from a clump of health? Whence did he obtain his weapons?

sa: अनवद्या ह्यसम्बुद्धाः प्रविष्टाः शत्रुसद्म तत्। शत्रुदेहमुपाक्रम्य तं कामं प्राप्नुयामहे॥
en: If we can accomplish our purpose by secretly entering the abode of our enemy and attacking his person, we shall never meet with obloquy.

sa: वरुणश्च ददौ तस्मै गदामशनिनिःस्वनाम्। दैत्यान्तकरणी घोरां नाम्ना कौमोदकी प्रभुः॥
en: Then lord Varuna gave him (Krishna) a club, named Kaumodaki, capable of killing every Daityas and producing a roar like that of the thunder.

sa: मया कथं नानृतमुक्तमद्य भवेत् कुरूणामृषभ ब्रवीहि। पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतामधर्मो न चोपवर्तेत न विभ्रमेच्च॥
en: O best of the Kurus, tell me how my speech may not become futile, how sin may not touch the daughter of the Panchala king and how she may not become unhappy.

sa: तथैवैकरथो गत्वा दक्षिणामजयद् दिशम्। धनौघं प्रापयामास कुरुराष्ट्र धनंजयः॥ एवं सर्वे महामत्मानः पाण्डवा मनुजोत्तमाः। परराष्ट्राणि निर्जित्य स्वराष्ट्रं ववृधुः पुरा॥
en: In the same way Dhananjaya conquered on a single car the whole of the South; and he sent immense booty to the kingdom of the Kurus. Thus did the foremost of men, the illustrious Pandavas.Conquering the kingdoms of others, extended their own kingdom in the time of yore.

sa: एष एव वधोऽस्माकं सुपर्याप्तस्तपोधन। यद् वयं संशितात्मानं प्रलोव्धुं त्वामिहागताः॥
en: I was enough death to us that we had at all come here to tempt such an ascetic of controlled soul as you are.

sa: अभूतपूर्वं शोकं मे मनः स्पष्टुमिवेच्छति। पश्यतो मे यथा नष्टा सीता श्रीरिव रूपिणी॥
en: My mind is about to be possessed by grief, which I had never experienced before, for in the very presence of mine the graceful Jānaki, like Lakşmī herself, has disappeared from view.

sa: ततो बद्ध्वा लतापाशैर्भीमं दुर्योधनः स्वयम्। मृतकल्पं तदा वीरं स्थलाज्जलमपातयत्॥
en: Duryodhana then himself bound Bhima with the cords of creepers and he then pushed from the land that dead like hero into the water.

sa: ततः सुभद्रा सौभद्रं केशवस्य प्रिया स्वसा। जयन्तमिव पौलोमी ख्यातिमन्तमजीजनत्॥
en: Then Subhadra, the beloved sister of Krishna, gave birth to an illustrious son, like Pauloma's daughter (Sachi) giving birth to Jayanta (son of Indra).

sa: स समावृतविद्यो मां भक्तां भजितुमर्हसि। गृहाण पाणिं विधिवन्मम मन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: "Your vow is now over; you should now fix your affection on me who love you. Accept my hand with ordained rites and Mantras."

sa: शमीक उवाच जानाम्युग्रप्रभावं त्वां तात सत्यगिरं तथा। नानृतं चोक्तपूर्वं ते नैतन्मिथ्या भविष्यति॥
en: Shamika said: My child, I know, you are greatly powerful and you are very truthful. You have never spoken a falsehood in your life and therefore your curse will never be false.

sa: ऋत्विग्भ्यः ससदस्येभ्यो ये तत्रासन्समागताः। तेभ्यश्च प्रददौ वित्तं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: The king bestowed money by hundreds and thousands on the Ritvijas and Sadasyas and on all that were present there (in that great sacrifice).

sa: तव द्युतिं कुपितकृतान्तसंनिभां निशम्य नश्चलति मनोऽव्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Our hearts, losing all equanimity, are trembling at your splendour, resembling that of the angry Yama.

sa: यत्र द्यूतार्णवे मग्नां द्रौपदीं नौरिवार्णवात्। धृतराष्ट्रो महाप्राज्ञः स्नुषां परमदुःखिताम्॥
en: The deliverance, by the greatly wise Dhritarashtra, of the sorrowful Draupadi who was drowned in the ocean of distress on account of the game;

sa: या बिभर्ति परं रूपं यस्या नास्त्युपमा भुवि। देवदानवयक्षाणामीप्सितां देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: Her beauty was such that she had no equal on earth. The Devas, the Danavas and the Yakshas could desire that celestials like beauty.

sa: अयं हि कामो दुपदस्य राज्ञो हदि स्थितो नित्यमनिन्दिताङ्गाः। धर्मेण विन्देत सुतां ममैताम्॥
en: O heroes of faultless features, it was the wish in the heart of the king Drupada that the long and strong armed Arjuna should marry in due religious form his this daughter.

sa: मुहूर्तयाते तस्मिंस्तु कण्वोऽप्याश्रममागमत्। शकुन्तला च पितरं ह्रिया नोपजगाम तम्॥
en: The moment the king had gone away, Kanva came to the hermitage. But Shakuntala did not go out to receive her father for shame.

sa: तं भीष्मः प्रत्युवाचेदं मद्रराजं कुरूद्वहः। आगतं मां विजानीहि कन्यार्थिनमरिन्दम॥
en: The supporter of the Kurus' honour, Bhishma replied to the king of Madra," chastiser of foes, know that I have come for a maiden.

sa: ततः प्रक्षाल्य पादौ सा विश्रान्तं मुनिमब्रवीत्। विनिधाय ततो भारं संनिधाय फलानि च॥
en: Shakuntala, then came to her fatigued father and washed his feet. She took down the heavy load that was on his shoulder and placed the fruits in proper order. Then she said-

sa: पित्रा च तव तत्कर्म नानुरूपमिवात्मनः। कृतं मुनिजनश्रेष्ठ येनाहं भृशदुःखितः॥
en: O best of Rishis, your father did nothing to meet with this treatment. I am pained as if it has been done to me.

sa: द्वारकायां सुभद्रा च कामयानेन भामिनी। वासुदेवस्यानुमते प्राप्ता चैव किरीटिना॥
en: Arjuna's taking of Subhadra by force with the permission of Krishna on the car which goes every where at the will of the rider;

sa: यद्वाक्यं श्रुतवांश्चाहं तथा च कथितं मया। आस्तीकस्य कवेर्विप्र श्रीमच्चरितमादितः॥
en: And as I heard it (from my father), I have narrated this blessed history of the learned Astika from the beginning (to the end).

sa: तदा भूरभवच्छन्ना जलोर्मिभिरनेकशः। रामणीयकमागच्छन्मात्रा सह भुजंगमाः॥
en: When there became countless watery waves, the snakes with their mother reached the island called Ramaniyaka.

sa: प्रशासति पुनः क्षत्रे धर्मेणेमां वसुंधराम्। ब्राह्मणाद्यास्ततो वर्णा लेभिरे मुदमुत्तमाम्॥
en: When thus the earth was again governed virtuously by the Kshatriyas, the other castes, having Brahmanas at their head, were filled with great joy.

sa: तत्ते वनं समासाद्य विजह्वः पन्नगास्तदा। अब्रुवंश्च महावीर्यं सुपर्णं पतगेश्वरम्॥
en: Having arrived at that forest, the snakes very much enjoyed themselves and then they commanded the king of the birds, Garuda of great strength.

sa: तान् महर्षिगणान् दृष्ट्वा शिरोभिरभिवाद्य च। उपोपविविशुः सर्वे कौरव्याः सपुरोहिताः॥
en: Seeing the great Rishis, the Kauravas with their priests bowed down their heads in salutations and they all took their seats before them (Rishis).

sa: अपिहरार्या मेघानां मागधा मनुना कृताः। कौशिको मणिमांश्चैव चक्राते चाप्यनुग्रहम्॥
en: Manu himself had made the country of the Magadhas to be free from draught Kaushika and Maniman also have favoured and blessed this country.

sa: एवमेतन्नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण। परितोपश्च मे वीर मम कार्यानुशासने॥
en: You have spoken the truth, O Laksmana, O foremost of men. I have been greatly delighted, O hero for your carrying out my orders.

sa: ऋषिपुत्रस्ततः कोपं चकारामर्षचोदितः॥ मातरं तां तथा दृष्ट्वा नीयमानां बलादिव।
en: Having seen his mother taken away as if by force, the son of the Rishi grew angry and became very much affected with sorrow.

sa: अग्निरों विषं शस्त्रं विप्रो भवति कोपितः। गुरुर्हि सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणः परिकीर्तितः॥ एवमादिभिरूपैस्तु सतां वै ब्राह्मणो मतः।
en: A Brahmana, when angry; becomes like the fire or the sun or the poison or a sharp weapon. A Brahmana is declared to be the preceptor of all creature. For these and other reasons the Brahmana is adored by all.

sa: ते तु दृष्ट्वैव राजानं जरासंधं नरर्षभाः। इदमूचुरमित्रघ्नाः सर्वे भरतसत्तम।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, seeing the king Jarasandha, those best of men, those slayers of foes (Krishna etc.) thus spoke to him,

sa: संस्वेदजा अण्डजाचोद्भिदश्च सरीसृपाः कृमयोऽथाप्सु मत्स्याः। तथाश्मानस्तृणकाष्ठं च सर्वे दिष्टक्षये स्वां प्रकृतिं भजन्ति॥
en: The Insects, the worms, all the oviparous creatures, vegetables, crawling animals, vermins, fishes, stones, wood, in fact all created things, are united with the Prakriti when they are freed from their acts.

sa: न जातु हृष्येन्महता धनेन वेदानधीयीतानहंकृतः स्यात्। नानाभावा बहवो जीवलोके दैवाधीना नष्टचेष्टाधिकाराः। तत् तत् प्राप्य न विहन्येत धीरो दिष्टं बलीय इति मत्वाऽऽत्मबुद्ध्या॥
en: No one should be proud of his great wealth; no one should feel exalted, because he has studied the entire Vedas. Men are of different dispositions in the world, but Destiny is supreme. Power and exertion are both futile and useless. Knowing Destiny to be supreme (over all), the wise should neither feel pride nor grief.

sa: मामकेन शरीरेण राज्यमेकः प्रशास्तु वः। अहं तन्वाभिनवया युवा काममवाप्नुयाम्॥
en: (Therefore), take any of you my decrepitude and rule the kingdom with my body. I would then enjoy myself with a renovated youthful body.

sa: द्रोण: शिष्यांस्ततः पार्थानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। समानीय तु ताशिष्यान् दुपदस्यासुखाय वै॥
en: With the intention of humiliating Draupada, Drona called together all his pupil and he spoke thus to them and to the sons of Kunti.

sa: सुखासीनं ततस्तं तु विश्रान्तमुपलक्ष्य च। अथापृच्छदृषिस्तत्र कश्चित् प्रस्तावयन् कथाः॥
en: Seeing that he had comfortably seated and observing that he had some rest after the fatigue, one of the Rishis started the conversation, saying,

sa: स नागभवने रात्रिं तामुषित्वा प्रतापवान्। उदितेऽभ्युत्थितः सूर्ये कौरव्यस्य निवेशनात्॥
en: The powerful hero passed the night in the mansion of the Naga and rose with the of the sun. From the mansion of Kaurava,

sa: शुक्र उवाच वृतोऽनया पतिर्वीर सुतया त्वं ममेष्टया। गृहाणेमां मया दत्तां महिषीं नहुषात्मज॥
en: Shukra said: O splendidly courageous king, you have been accepted by my dear daughter as her husband. I bestow her on you. Therefore, O son of Nahusha, accept her as your wife.

sa: ततो भीमः शनैर्भुक्त्वा तदन्नं पुरुषर्षभः। वायुपस्पृश्य संहृष्टस्तस्थौ युधि महाबलः॥
en: That best of men, the greatly strong Bhima, leisurely ate up all the food and then washing himself he stood up cheerfully to fight.

sa: न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति। हविषा कृष्णवर्देव भूय एवाभिवर्धते॥
en: But desires never die. They are never satiated by indulgence. By indulgence they flame up like the sacrificial fire with ghee poured into it.

sa: श्वश्रूणामविशेषण प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण च। शिरसा वन्द्य चरणौ कुशलं ब्रूहि पार्थिवम्॥
en: Without making any distinction, do you, in my name, with folded hands, bow to my mothers-in-law and then ask the well-being of the kingdom.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वातिबलं चैव प्राकम्पन्त सुरास्ततः। परस्परं च प्रत्यघ्नन् सर्वप्रहरणान्युत॥
en: The celestials, having seen him of excessive strength, began to tremble in fear; and (having been confused) struck one another with all their weapons.

sa: गृहमानीय बनीमः क्रतुरेवं भवेन्न सः। अपरे त्वब्रुवंस्तत्र नागाः पण्डितमानिनः॥
en: Let us carry him to our home and keep him bound, so that the sacrifice may not take place.” Others, thinking themselves wise, said,

sa: अपरे त्वब्रुवंस्तत्र ऋत्विजोऽस्य भवामहे। यज्ञविघ्नं करिष्यामो दीयतां दक्षिणा इति॥
en: Others said, “Let us become the Ritviks of the king and obstruct the sacrifice by saying at the very outset, 'Give us our Dakshina."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तामथो ब्राह्मणी राजा विज्ञाय नहुषात्मजः॥ गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे पाणावुजहार ततोऽवटात्। उद्धृत्य चैनां तरसा तस्मात् कूपान्नराधिपः॥ आमन्त्रयित्वा सुश्रोणी ययाति स्वपुरं ययौ। गते तु नाहुषे तस्मिन् देवयान्यप्यनिन्दिता॥ उवाच शोकसंतप्ता घूर्णिकामागतां पुरः।
en: Vaishampayana said : The son of Nahusha, king (Yayati) having learnt that she was the daughter of a Brahmana, took hold of her right hand and raised her up from that well. The king, after speedily raising her from the well and speaking sweet and courteous words to that beauty of tapering thighs, went away to his own capital. After the departure of the son of Nahusha (Yayati), the faultless featured Devayani spoke in sorrow to Ghurnika who came there.

sa: वितथं नोक्तपूर्वं मे स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा। घृतपूर्णं कुण्डशतं क्षिप्रमेव विधीयताम्॥ सुगुप्तेषु च देशेषु रक्षा चैव विधीयताम्। शीताभिरद्भिरष्ठीलामिमां च परिषेचय॥
en: I have not spoken an untruth even in jest, why then will my words be futile! Let one hundred jars, filled with ghee, be brought in the proper way; let them be placed at a concealed place and let cool water be sprinkled on this ball of flesh.
