sa: शुक्र उवाच नाहं मृषा द्रवीभ्येतज्जरां प्राप्तोऽसि भूमिप। जरां त्वेतां त्वमन्यस्मिन् संक्रामय यदीच्छसि॥
en: Shukra said : I never speak an untruth, O king, (see), you have been immediately attacked by old age. But if you like, you can transfer this decrepitude to some other man.

sa: नैषा तव ममैषेति ततस्तौ मन्युराविशत्। तस्या रूपेण सम्पत्तौ विगतस्नेहसौहृदौ॥
en: They each exclaimed, "She is mine, not yours.” Maddened by her beauty, they lost all love and friendship (that they bore for each other).

sa: ततोऽर्धरात्र उत्थाय सूदमानाय्य सत्वरम्। उवाच राजा संस्मृत्य ब्राह्मणस्य प्रतिश्रुतम्॥
en: Waking at midnight and remembering his promise to the Brahmana, the king soon summoned his cook and spoke to him thus. The King said:

sa: स ताञ्छक्त्यवरान् पुत्रान् वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः। भक्षयामास संक्रुद्धः सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
en: He (the Rakshasas) devoured in anger all the sons of the illustrious Vasishtha, the younger brothers of Shakti as a lion devours smali animals.

sa: उग्रे तपसि वर्तन्ते पितरचोदयन्ति माम्। निविशस्वेति दुःखार्ताः संतानस्य चिकीर्षया॥
en: I am a man, engaged in severe penances, but my ancestors, afflicted with grief, have told me, "Get yourself married to beget a son."

sa: बहवः पार्थिवाः सौम्य हताः सबलवाहनाः। लवणेन महाबाहो युध्यमाना महाबलाः।७।।
en: O gentle one, O foremost of men, Lavana had slain in conflict many hundred highly powerful kings with their army and conveyances. at to

sa: ऋतुकाले ततः स्नाता कदाचिद्वासुके: स्वसा। भर्तारं वै यथान्यायमुपतस्थे महामुनिम्॥
en: One day the sister of Vasuki, when her season of impurity came, bathed according to custom and went to the great Rishi, her husband.

sa: स डौण्डुभं परित्यज्य रूपं विप्रर्षभस्तदा। स्वरूपभास्वरं भूयः प्रतिपेदे महायशाः॥
en: was Souti said : That illustrious man and the best of Brahmanas then left his snake-body and attained his own form with original brightness.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तेषु तत्रोपविष्टेषु ब्राह्मणेषु महात्मसु। रुक्षुक्रोश गहनं वनं गत्वाऽतिदुःखितः॥
en: Sauti replied : While the noble Brahmanas were sitting round the dead body, Ruru, much aggrieved, retired into a deep forest and wept aloud.

sa: उपमन्युरुवाच सदसद् व्यक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः। नित्यकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: Upamanyu said I beg boons from Him whom Brahmavadins have described as existent and nonexistent, manifest and unmanifest, eternal or immutable, One and many.

sa: महेन्द्रो लोकपालेभ्यो लोकपालास्तु पुत्रका।६७।। मनवे सूर्यपुत्राय ददुः खड्गं सुविस्तरम्।
en: Vasava gave it to the Regents of the quarters. The Regents, O son, gave that large sword to Manu the son of the Sun-god.

sa: इदं ब्रह्मा पुरा कृत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः। सर्वस्तवानां राजत्वे दिव्यानां समकल्पयत्॥
en: Brahman, the Grandfather of all the universe, having in days of yore, composed it, gave to it the foremost place among all excellent hymns.

sa: तदेतदाएं माद्रेय प्रमाणं कर्तुमर्हसि। असेच पूजा कर्तव्या सदा युद्धविशारदैः॥
en: You should, O son of Madri, consider what the Rishis have said as sufficient proof. All persons skilled in battle should adore the sword.

sa: तस्माद् धर्मप्रधानेन भवितव्य यतात्मना। तथा च सर्वभूतेषु वर्तितव्यं यथात्मनि॥
en: Therefore, one should live with controlled soul, paying his best attention to Virtue. One should also treat all creatures as he should do himself.

sa: यो यस्तेषामपचरेत् तमाचक्षीत वै द्विजः। अयं मे न शृणोतीति तस्मिन् राजा प्रधारयेत्॥
en: Of them those who will violate (these commands) be reported to the king.-This one does not care commands!-upon such a complaint being lodged by a Brahmana, the king should punish the offender.

sa: असाधुश्चैव पुरुषो लभते शीलमेकदा। साधोश्चापि ह्यसाधुभ्यः शोभना जायते प्रजा॥
en: Sometimes a wicked man is seen to imbibe good conduct from a pious person. It is seen that good children spring from wicked persons.

sa: बाणवेधे परं यत्नमकरोच्चैव गौतमः। चक्राङ्गान् स च नित्यं वै सर्वतो वनगोचरान्॥ जघान गौतमो राजन् यथा दस्युगणास्तथा। हिंसापटुघृणाहीन: सदा प्राणिवधे रतः॥ गौतमः संनिकर्षेण दस्युभिः समतामियात्।
en: He began to practise with great zeal the art of archery. Every day, like the other robbers living there, Gautama, o king, went into the forest and killed a large number of wild cranes. Always engaged in killing living creatures, he became well-skilled in that act and soon became shorn of mercy. For his intimacy with robbers he became one like one of them.

sa: कामलोभानुबन्धेन पुरा ते यदसूयितम्। मया स्नेहमविज्ञाय तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Unconscious of the great love shown by you towards me,I through the influency of desire and avarice, could not show good will towards you.

sa: सर्वं सर्वेण सर्वत्र क्रियमाणं च पूजय। स्वधर्मे यत्र रागस्ते कामं धर्मो विधीयताम्॥
en: One should always respect the practices of his own caste. Do you try, therefore, to act in such a way that you may have faith in the practices of your own caste.

sa: अपि चोदाहरन्तीमं धर्मशास्त्रविदो जनाः। अश्वानां श्यामकर्णानां सहस्त्रेण स मुच्यते।।७।
en: Persons conversant with the scriptures also opine that such a man may be purified by giving away a thousand horses with dark ears. are

sa: भीष्म उवाच स्पृहयामि द्विजातिभ्यो येषां ब्रह्म परं धनम्। येषां स्वप्रत्ययः स्वर्गस्तपः स्वाध्यायसाधनम्॥
en: Bhishma said I like those twiceborn persons whose highest wealth is Brahma, whose heaven is their knowledge of the soul, and whose penances are formed by their diligent study of the Vedas.

sa: यस्माद् यदभिजायेत तत् तत्रैव प्रलीयते। लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमानि सृज्यन्ते चान्तरात्मना॥
en: What is produced becomes merged in the producing cause. Created by the Supreme Soul after another, these principles are destroyed in a reverse order.

sa: पुरा जरा कलेवरं विजर्जरीकरोति ते। बलाङ्गरूपहारिणी निधत्स्व केवलं निधिम्॥
en: Decrepitude very soon weakens your body and robs you of your strength and limbs and beauty. Do you, therefore, seek that one only treasure.

sa: द्वन्द्वमेति च निर्द्वन्द्वस्तासु तास्विह योनिषु। शीर्षरोगेऽक्षिरोगे च दन्तशूले गलग्रहे॥ जलोदरे तृषारोगे ज्वरगण्डे विषूचके। श्वित्रकुष्ठेऽग्निदग्धे च सिध्मापस्मारयोरपि॥ यानि चान्यानि द्वन्द्वानि प्राकृतानि शरीरिषु। उत्पद्यन्ते विचित्राणि तान्येषोऽप्यभिमन्यते॥
en: Though above both happiness and misery, it is thus that he subjects himself to happiness and misery. It is thus also that, though above all discases, the Soul considers himself to be afflicted by headache, opthalmia, toothache, affections of the throat, abdominal dropsy, burning thirst, enlargement of glands, cholera, vitiligo, leprosy, burns, asthma, phthisis, epilepsy, and various other diseases from which embodied creatures suffer.

sa: मदिराश्व इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः। धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च निरतो योऽभवत् सदा॥
en: He was known by the name of Madirashva and ruled the Earth as her master. He was continually given to the study of the Vedas as also of the science of arms.

sa: सत्त्वं वहति शुद्धात्मन् परं नारायण प्रभुम्। प्रभुर्वहति शुद्धात्मा परमात्मानमात्मना॥
en: Darkness then carries them to the highest end of Goodness. Goodness then bears them,O you of pure soul, to the Supreme and powerful Narayana.

sa: सर्वानेव तु राजर्षिः सम्पूज्याथ प्रणम्य च। कुशलप्रशनमकरोत् सर्वेषां राजसत्तमः॥
en: The royal sage Ikshvaku bowed his head and adored them all. That best of king then enquired after the welfare of all of them.

sa: कन्यां तां प्रतिगृह्मैव भार्यां परमशोभनाम्। उवास मुदितस्तत्र स्वाश्रमे विगतज्वरः॥
en: Having taken as his wife that beautiful lady, the Rishi continued to live in his own hermitage freed from every sort of mental trouble.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अयं पाद्यं च दत्त्वा स तेभ्यस्तत्र समागमे। अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतः स्वशक्त्या किं करोमि वः॥
en: Bhishma said In that meeting, the Brahmana gave them water to wash their feet, and the usual articles of the Arghya. Highly pleased, he then addressed them, saying,—What shall I do for you all to the best of my power.

sa: उत्तरां मां दिशं विद्धि दृष्टं स्त्रीचापलं च ते। स्थविराणामपि स्त्रीणां बाधते मैथुनज्वरः॥
en: Know me as the embodiment of the Northern point of the compass. You have seen the lightness of the female character. Even old women are tortured by the desires of sexual union.

sa: यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चेदं परिकीर्तयेत्। नाशुभं विद्यते तस्य मनसापि प्रमादतः॥
en: No evil overtakes the person who listens every day to this story or who recites it every day, even if error possesses his mind.

sa: परचक्षुषि चात्मानं ये न पश्यन्ति पार्थिव॥ आत्मच्छायाकृतीभूतं तेऽपि संवत्सरायुषः।
en: Those men, O king, who can no longer behold their own images reflected in the eyes of others, have but one year to live.

sa: धर्म उवाच द्विजाते पश्य मां धर्ममहं त्वां द्रष्टुमागतः। जप्यस्यास्य फलं यत्तत् सम्प्राप्तं तच्च मे शृणु॥
en: Dharma said O twice-born one, see me who am Dharma. I have come here for seeing you. You have acquired the meed of this recitation in which you had been engaged. Listen to me as to what that rewards is.

sa: शैलराजसुता चैव देवी तत्राभवत् पुरा। तत्र दिव्यं तपस्तेपे कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तदा॥
en: The daughter of the king of mountains, viz., the goddess Parvati, was also there. There near that summit, the Island-born (Vyasa) practised extraordinary austerities.

sa: स देव्या दर्शितः साक्षात् प्रीतास्मीति तदा किल। जष्यमावर्तयंस्तूष्णीं न स तां किञ्चिदब्रवीत्॥
en: The goddess (of Gayatri or Savitri) appeared before him and said,-I am pleased with you.-Continuing to recite the sacred Mantra, the Brahmana remained silent and spoke not a word to the goddess.

sa: दुर्बुद्धिरकृतप्रज्ञश्चले मनसि तिष्ठति। चलामेव गतिं याति निरयं वा नियच्छति॥
en: That Reciter of wicked understanding and uncleaned soul who engages in work with an unstable mind, obtains an unstable end or goes into hell.

sa: तस्मिन् दिव्ये वने रम्ये देवदेवर्षिसंकुले। आस्थितः परमं योगमृषिः पुत्रार्थपच्युतः॥
en: In those delightful and celestial forests populous with gods and heavenly Rishis, the great Rishi remained, engaged in high Yogacontemplation, for getting a son.

sa: स्वरूपतामात्मकृतं च विस्तरं कुलान्वयं द्रव्यसमृद्धिसंचयम्। नरो हि सर्वो लभते यथाकृतं शुभाशुभेनात्मकृतेन कर्मणा॥
en: Through acts good and bad done by himself in his pristine lives, man acquires gold and animals, and wives, and children, and honour of birth, and costly possessions, and his entire affluence.

sa: माता पुत्रः पिता भ्राता भार्या मित्रजनस्तथा। अष्टापदपदस्थाने लक्षमुद्रेव लक्ष्यते॥
en: The mother, the son, the father, the brother, the wife, and friends, are like lines drawn with gold by the side of gold itself.

sa: तं महात्मा स्वयं प्रीत्या देव्या सह महाद्युतिः॥ जातमात्रं मुनेः पुत्र विधिनोपानयत् तदा।
en: The great and the highly effulgent Mahadeva, accompanied by the Goddess, and moved by affection, came there and soon after the birth of the Muni's son invested him with the sacred thread.

sa: सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी॥ ध्रुवं न व्यथसेऽद्य त्वं धैर्यात् सत्यपराक्रम।
en: Your understanding, however, so firm and so endued with visions of the truth has not been moved. 0 you of invincible prowess, verily you are unmoved to-day on account of your fortitude.

sa: यदा त्वमपि विप्रर्षे त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। जातकौतूहलो नित्यं सिद्धश्चरसि साक्षिवत्॥
en: O twice-born Rishi, crowned with ascetic success, you walk about moved by curiosity, through the universe of mobile and immobile objects, seeing all things.

sa: इमां च त्वं नरव्याघ्र श्रोतुमर्हसि मे कथाम्। पुरा शक्रस्य कथितां नारदेन महर्षिणा॥
en: This particular subject, however, which you wish me to describe was in days of yore the subject of conversation between the celestial Rishi Narada and the king of the gods, viz., Indra.

sa: प्रयलेनापि चारक्षच्चितं पुत्रस्य वै पिता॥ व्यभजच्चापि संरम्भाद् दुःखवासं तथावसत्।
en: Fathers, with great care, try to keep sons in good humour, or, through fear, distributing their wealth among children, live in misery and affliction.

sa: इत्युक्तवचनां देवीं प्रीत्यर्थं च ननन्दतुः॥ नारदश्चात्र देवर्षिवृत्रहन्ता च वासवः।
en: After the goddess had said so, the celestial Rishi Narada, and Vasava the killer of Vritra, for pleasing her, offered her a joyful welcome.

sa: गृहीत्वा ये च गच्छन्ति ये न यान्ति च तान् मृतान्। तेऽप्यायुषः प्रमाणेन स्वेन गच्छन्ति जन्तवः॥
en: They who have come to the crematorium with the dead bodies of their relatives, and they who sit by those bodies themselves go away from the world for their own acts when the allotted periods of their own lives expire.

sa: न वोऽस्त्यस्मिन् सुते स्नेहो बाले मधुरभाषिणि। यस्य भाषितमात्रेण प्रसादमधिगच्छत॥
en: Surely, you have no love for that sweetspeeched little child, whose words, as soon as they left his lips, used to please you greatly!

sa: अथ यद् दुःखसंयुक्तमप्रीतिकरमात्मनः। प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येव तन्न संरभ्य चिन्तयेत्॥
en: A disagreeable state of sorrow to oneself, is due to nothing but the quality of Darkness. One should never think of it in fear.

sa: वीतसम्मोहदोषश्च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥ असक्तः सर्वभूतेषु सक्तात्मेव च लक्ष्यते। अदी संशयो वाग्मी तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is unattached to all objects of attachment (for others). For all that he seems to be attached to all things. He does not suffer long from the influence of any doubt. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

sa: सुखासुखे जरामृत्यू लाभालाभौ प्रियाप्रिये। इति चैकोनविंशोऽयं द्वन्द्वयोग इति स्मृतः॥
en: Happiness and sorrow, decrepitude and death, gain and loss, the agreeable and the disagreeable,-these form the nineteenth principle and are called pairs of opposites.

sa: परेषां यदसूयेत न तत् कुर्यात् स्वयं नरः। यो ह्यसू युस्तथायुक्तः सोऽवहासं नियच्छति॥
en: A person should not himself do that act which, if done by another, will bring censure on him. Indeed, by doing an act that one censures in others, one meets with ridicule.

sa: उदानस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूद् व्यानस्तस्याभवत् सुतः। अपानश्च ततो ज्ञेयः प्राणश्चापि ततोऽपरः॥
en: From Samana originated a son calle Udana. From Udana originated Vyana. From Vyana arose Apana, and lastly from Apana originated the wind called Prana.

sa: सूर्यं सदोपतिष्ठेत न च सूर्योदये स्वपेत्। सायं प्रातर्जपेत् संध्यां तिष्ठन् पूर्वां तथेतराम्॥
en: The Sun-god should be always adored. One should not sleep after sunrise. Morning and evening the prayers, should be said, sitting with face turned towards the East and towards the West respectively.

sa: एषा पूर्वगता वृत्तिाह्मणस्य विधीयते॥ ज्ञानागमेन कर्माणि कुर्वन् कर्मसु सिध्यति।
en: This preliminary course of conduct is first sanctioned for a Brahmana. Subsequently, when knowledge comes, he should begin work, for success lies in works.

sa: एतत् तु महदाश्चर्यं यदयं पर्वतोत्तमः। कम्पितः सहसा तेन वायुनातिप्रवायता॥
en: This, however, is greatly wonderful, viz., that this foremost of mountains should thus be suddenly shaken by that wind which has begun to below.

sa: त्वं हि विप्रेन्द्र कात्स्येंन मोक्षधर्ममुपाससे। साकल्यं मोक्षधर्मस्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: You, O foremost of Brahmanas, are a master of the entire religion of Liberation. I wish to hear fully of the religion of Liberation.

sa: पौरुषं कारणं केचिदाहुः कर्मसु मानवाः। दैवमेके प्रशंसन्ति स्वभावमपरे जनाः॥
en: Regarding acts men hold that Exertion is their root. Others say that Necessity is their cause. Others, again, hold that Nature is the cause.

sa: द्वापरे विप्लवं यान्ति वेदाः कलियुगे तथा। दृश्यन्ते नापि दृश्यन्ते कलेरन्ते पुन: किल॥
en: In Dvapara age as also in the Kali, the Vedas become of doubtful interpretation. Towards the close of Kali again, it is doubtful if they ever can be seen by the eye.

sa: इच्छाद्वेषाभवैर्दुःखैः प्रकर्षो यत्र जायते। तत्र या नृपते वृत्तिस्तत् प्रयोजनमिष्यते॥
en: The sorrow begotten by wish or hatred multiplies itself greatly. The conduct, O king, that one follows in such a matter is called Prayojanam.

sa: भवति चात्र श्लोकः-अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यश्चरते मुनिः। न तस्य सर्वभूतेभ्यो भयमुत्पद्यते क्वचित्॥
en: There are some verses on this subject-that person who, observing the vow of silence roams without giving any creature cause of fear, is never filled with any fear himself by any creature.

sa: स्नेहजानिह ते पाशान् वक्ष्यामि शृणु तान् मम। सकर्णकेन शिरसा शक्याः श्रोतुं विजानता॥
en: I shall now describe to you all the fetters which originate from the affections. Hear them with attention. Indeed, they can be heard with profit by one who is endued with knowledge.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम्। अरिष्टनेमिना प्रोक्तं सगरायानुपृच्छते॥
en: Bhishma said-I shall in this connection recite to you the old narrative that was uttered by Arishtanemi to Sagara who had sought his advice.

sa: विद्यां मानापमानाभ्यामात्मानं तु प्रमादतः। यस्य सर्वे समारम्भा निराशीर्बन्धना द्विज॥
en: One should always protect his prosperity against his anger; his penances from pride; his knowledge from honour and disgrace; and his soul from mistakes.

sa: अर्थकामौ परित्यज्य विशोको विगतज्वरः। तृष्णामोहौ तु संत्यज्य चरामि पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: Knowing both riches and pleasure, and thirst and mistake, I wander over the Earth, freed from grief and every sort of anxiety of heart.

sa: ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मतन्त्रस्थास्तपस्तेषां न नश्यति। ब्रह्म धारयतां नित्यं व्रतानि नियमांस्तथा॥
en: The Brahmanas are always devoted to the Brahma-scriptures and practising vows and restraints, are capable of understanding Brahima. Their penances, therefore, never prove fruitless.

sa: घुष्यते ह्यचलं स्थानं कस्य त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्। वर्षते तपते कोऽन्यो ज्वलते तेजसा च कः॥
en: Who else is there whose place is described as unchangeable and adored with reverence by the three worlds? Who else is there who pours rain, gives heat, and blazes forth in Energy?

sa: सर्वान् वेदानधीयीत शुश्रूषुर्ब्रह्मचर्यवान्। ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि न तेन न स वै द्विजः॥
en: He who has mastered all the Vedas, having served dutifully his preceptor and practised the vow of celibacy, he who knows all the Richs, Yajushes, and Samans, is not a twice-born one.

sa: अथ तौ दानवश्रेष्ठौ वेदान् गृह्य सनातनान्। रसां विविशतुस्तूर्णमुदक्पूर्वे महोदधौ॥
en: Having seized the eternal Vedas, the two powerful Danavas, quickly dived into the ocean of waters which they saw and proceeded to its bottom.

sa: तथा च नः श्रुतो ब्रह्मन् कथ्यमानस्त्वयानघ। हव्यकव्यभुजो विष्णुरुदक्पूर्वे महोदधौ॥ यच्च तत् कथितं पूर्वं त्वया हयशिरो महत्। तच्च दृष्टं भगवता ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना॥
en: You have also, O twice-born one, described to us other topics. You have said also to us of that huge form, with the Divine head, of Vishnu, the eater of the libations and other offerings made in sacrifices,-the form, viz., cast. That form was seen by the illustrious Brahman, otherwise known by the name of Parameshthi.

sa: धर्मोऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते जिज्ञासार्थं तवानघ। प्राप्तः सत्यं च ज्ञात्वा प्रीतिर्मे परमा त्वयि॥
en: O sinless one, I am Dharma! All glory to you! I came here, O truthloving one, to try you, and I am well pleased with you by knowing you to be virtuous.

sa: ये केचन स्वध्ययनाः प्राप्ता यजनयाज । कथं ते चानुशोचेयुायेयुर्वाप्यशोभनम्।
en: They who, by studying the Vedas, become competent for celebrating sacrifices for themselves and others, need no. regret or fear any sort of evil.

sa: येष्वलोभस्तथामोहो ये च सत्यार्जवे स्थिताः। तेषु कौन्तेय रज्येथा येषां न भ्रश्यते पुनः॥
en: They are perfectly contended. They have of judgement originating from covetousness. They always follow truth and sincerity. Their hearts never deviate from righteousness. You should always respect them, O son of Kunti!

sa: नारद उवाच विनीय दुःखमबला साऽऽत्मनैवायतेक्षणा। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा लतेवावर्जिता तदा॥
en: Narada said The lady having large eyes, controlling her grief by self-exertion, addressed the Grandfather, with joined hands and bending low like a creeper.

sa: पुरुषेषु स्वरूपेण पुरुषस्त्वं भविष्यसि। स्त्रीषु स्त्रीरूपिणी चैव तृतीयेषु नपुंसकम्॥
en: You will become a male in all male beings, a female in all female beings, and a eunuch in all those who are so.

sa: न हर्तव्यं परधनमिति धर्मः सनातनः॥ मन्यन्ते बलवन्तस्तं दुर्बलैः सम्प्रवर्तितम्।
en: One should not take other's properties. That is an eternal duty. Powerful men consider it as one that has been introduced by the weak.

sa: दिव्यैः पुष्पैः समाकीर्णमन्तरिक्षं समन्ततः॥ आसीत् किल महाराज शुकाभितपने तदा।
en: The entire sky became covered with celestial flowers showered from heaven at that moment when Shuka thus cut through that impenetrable barrier, O king.

sa: इत्युक्तो जाजलिर्भूतैः प्रत्युवाच महातपाः। पश्येयं तमहं प्राज्ञं तुलाधारं यशस्विनम्॥
en: Thus addressed by those beings, Jajali of austere penances replied to them, saying,-I shall see that famous Tuladhara who is endued with such wisdom!

sa: इति ब्रुवाणं तमृषि रक्षास्युद्धृत्य सागरात्। अब्रुवन् गच्छ पन्थानमास्थायेमं द्विजोत्तम्॥
en: When the Rishi said this, those superhuman beings raised him from the sea, and said to him,-best of twice-born one, go along this road!

sa: ततस्तु कालसमये बभूवुस्तेऽथ पक्षिणः। बुबुधे तांस्तु स मुनिर्जातपक्षान् कुलिङ्गकान्॥
en: In course of time the young ones grew and became endued with wings. The Muni knew that the young Kulingas had grown up so.

sa: यच्च पैतामहं स्थानं ब्रह्मराशिसमुद्भवम्। गुहायां पिहितं नित्यं तद् दमेनाभिगम्यते॥
en: That eternal region of the grandfather which originates from Vedic penances, and which is concealed in a cave, can only be acquired by self-control.

sa: अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च द्वयं देहे प्रतिष्ठितम्। मृत्युमापद्यते मोहात् सत्येनापद्यतेऽमृतम्॥
en: Both immortality and Death are in the body. One meets with Death through ignorance and loss of judgement; while Immortality is gained by Truth.

sa: ततस्तेषु प्रलीनेषु जाजलिर्जातविस्मयः। सिद्धोऽस्मीति मतिं चक्रे ततस्तं मान आविशत्॥
en: When they had thus gone away for ever, Jajali wondered much and thought that he had gained ascetic success. Then pride entered his heart.

sa: आदित्यानां भवान् विष्णुर्वसूनां चैव पावकः। पक्षिणां वैनतेयस्त्वमनन्तो भुजगेषु च॥
en: Among the Adityas, you are Vishnu (Upendra), among the Vasus, you are Pavaka, among birds you are Garuda, and among snakes you are Ananta.

sa: स एव सुभगो भूत्वा पुनर्भवति दुर्भगः। व्यापत्तिं कर्मणां दृष्ट्वा जुगुप्सन्ति जनाः सदा॥
en: One who performs acts at first acquires prosperity, but then he once more meets with adversity. Seeing the destruction of the merits of) acts, the wise do not speak highly of them.

sa: कारणाद् धर्ममन्विच्छन्न लोकचरितं चरेत्। यो हन्याद् यश्च मां स्तौति तत्रापि शृणु जाजले॥
en: One should perform his duty guided by reasons, instead of blindly following the conduct of the world. Listen now, O Jajali, how I treat him who injures and him who praises me.

sa: लीलयाल्पं यथा गात्रात् प्रमृज्यादात्मनो रजः। बहुयत्नेन महता दोषनिर्हरणं तथा॥
en: As one should with care remove stains from his body before they become thick, similarly one should with great efforts, wash off his sins.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनमदृश्यः पुरुषोत्तमः। विसृज्य तानृषीन् सर्वान् कामपि प्रसृतो दिशम्॥
en: Having said these words to all those Rishis, the invisible Narayana left them and went to some place that was not known to them.

sa: इत्युक्ता राक्षसास्तेन शूलपट्टिशपाणयः॥ कृत्वा तं खण्डशः पापं दस्युभ्यः प्रददुस्तदा।
en: Thus ordered by him, the Rakshasas, armed with lances and battle-axes, hacked that sinful wretch into pieces and gave them away to the robbers.

sa: ततो वै द्वापरं नाम मिश्रः कालो भविष्यति। द्विपादहीनो धर्मश्च युगे तस्मिन् भविष्यति॥
en: On the termination of the Treta, will come the mixed Yoga known by the name of Dvapara. In that cycle, virtue will lose two quarters and only two quarters thereof will remain.

sa: तस्मात् सनत्कुमारत्वं योऽलभत् स्वेन कर्मणा। यस्मिश्च सर्वभूतानि प्रलयं यान्ति संक्षयम्॥ स मनः सर्वभूतानां प्रद्युम्न परिपठ्यते।
en: He who takes his his rise, from that Sankarshana, by his own acts, Sanatkumara, and in whom all creatures merge when the universal dissolution sets in, is the Mind of all creatures and is called by the name of Praddyumna.

sa: ततः स्वरथमारोष्य मद्राणामधिपं रणे। अपोवाह रणात् तूर्णे कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: The mighty car-warrior car-warrior Kritavarman, speedily taking up the ruler of the Madras on his car carried him away from the field of battle.

sa: नमस्कृत्य कुमाराय सेनान्ये शक्तिपाणये। अहं सेनापतिस्तेऽद्य भविष्यामि न संशयः॥
en: “Having bowed down to Kumara, the god of war, who has a lance in his hand, I shall today be your general, no doubt.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथा प्रतिसमादिष्टः कालिङ्गो वाहिनीपतिः। कथमद्भुतकर्माणं भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥ चरन्तं गदया वीरं दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम्। योधयामास समरे कालिङ्गः सह सेनया॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did the Kalinga king, that commander of a large army, having been asked by my son and supported by his troops, fight in battle with that doer of wonderful deeds, the mighty Bhimasena, that hero who roved over the field of battle with his club?

sa: शस्त्रैश्च बहुभि राजञ्जनतुस्तावकान् रणे। ते हन्यमानाः समरे तावका भरतर्षभ॥
en: They also, O monarch siew in battle your warriors with innumerable shafts. O foremost of men, your troops, through thus smitten down in battle,

sa: प्रायात्रिकं चानयताशु सर्वं दना पूर्ण वीर कांस्यं च हैमम्। आनीय मालामवबध्य चाङ्गे प्रवादयन्त्वाशु जयाय ॥
en: O hero, bring speedily all auspicious articles required at the time of setting ous (for battle) and brass and golden vessel filled with curds. Bring garlands of flowers and decorate my person with them; strike up, also, kettledrums for victory.

sa: जह्वस्तेषां बलानीकं दुर्जयं समरे परैः। तदनीकमनीकेन समरे वीक्ष्य पातितम्॥
en: Slew in battle that division of your army difficult of being conquered by the enemy. Beholding their division crushed by the division of Iravat,

sa: पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तावुभौ संयति दारुणौ। सम्बन्धिभावं रक्षन्तौ महत् कर्म करिष्यतः॥
en: Each, at the head of their separate Akshauhini, will make fierce attempt and observing the duties of the relationship they will do great deeds.

sa: संजय उवाच अकरोत् तुमुलं युद्धं भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा। भीमसेनभयादिच्छन् पुत्रांस्तारयितुं तव॥ पूर्वाह्ने तन्महारौद्रं राज्ञां युद्धमवर्तत। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च मुख्यशूरविनाशनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, fought a fierce battle, desirous of saving your sons from their fear of Bhimasena. In that morning, a most dreadful battle was fought between the kings of the Kaurava and the Pandava hosts, in which many best warriors were slain.

sa: महारथौघविपुलः समुद्र इव घोषवान्। भीष्मेण धार्तराष्ट्राणां व्यूहः प्रत्यङ्मुखो युधि॥
en: With innumerable great car-warriors, roaring like the very ocean, the arıny of Dhritarashtra's son, arrayed by Bhishma, stood ready for battle, facing the west.

sa: तानि नागसहस्राणि भूमिपालशतानि च। तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य नाभ्यवर्तन्त सर्वशः॥
en: When those thousands of elephants and hundreds of kings came within the reach of scen Arjuna's arrows, they could not make any further advance.

sa: स पाण्डवानां महतीं महेष्वासो महाद्युतिः॥ वेगेनाभ्यद्रवत् सेनां किरञ्छरशतैः शितैः।
en: Then that mighty champion (Drona) of great effulgence, charged, with headlong speed, the army of the sons of Pandu, shooting hundreds of sharpened shafts.

sa: आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन योद्धव्य इतरो जनः। मायायुद्धेन मायावी इत्येतद् धर्मनिश्चयः॥
en: Ordinary men ought to be fought without artifice, and with deceptive artifices one versed in them; this is the rule that has been settled,

sa: क्रोडैः क्रोडानभिनन्तो घोणाभिश्च परस्परम्। निपेतुः सहसा राजन् सुवेगाभिहता भुवि॥
en: Struck one another with their chests and noses. Overthrown by their own impetuosity, O king, they began to fall down suddenly on the earth.

sa: तस्य मौर्वी च मुष्टिं च स्थानं चालक्ष्य पाण्डवः। श्रुत्वा मन्त्रं भवप्रोक्तं जग्राहाचिन्त्यविक्रमः॥
en: Thereupon, seeing the mode of his grasping the bow, drawing the string, placing his legs and hearing also the mantras uttered by Bhava, Pandu's son of infinite prowess duly learnt them all.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सव्यसाची महारथः। कालोऽयमिति संचिन्त्य शिखण्डिनमचोदयत्॥
en: Hearing those words of Shikhandin, the mighty car-warrior Savyasachi (Arjuna) thinking that was the right moment (to strike Bhishma) urged the former on saying

sa: बाह्रीकस्तु रणे राजन् धृष्टकेतुममर्षणः। शरैर्बहुभिरानछेत् सिहनादमथानदत्॥
en: O king, great Balhika, sending up a lionlike roar, weakened the wrathful Dhrishtaketu with countless arrows.

sa: सोऽपराह्ने महाराज संग्रामस्तुमुलोऽभवत्। एकस्य च बहूनां च समेतानां रणाजिरे॥
en: That afternoon, mighty sovereign a dreadful battle was fought on the field between Bhurishravas alone on side and many united together on the other.

sa: अवश्यं हि मया राजंस्तव वाच्य हितं सदा। अशक्याः पाण्डवा जेतुं देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: It is my bounded duty, O king, to tell always what will be for your good. The Pandavas are incapable of being vanquished even by the very gods led by Vasava himself.

sa: पाण्डवैः सह राजेन्द्र तव सेनासु भारत। अग्निमारुतवद् राजन्नाह्वयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: United with the sons of Pandu, O chief among kings, O Bharata, they will sweep through your army like fire and wind challenging them.

sa: अपि तत् पूरयांचक्रे धनुर्धरवरो युधि। यत्तद् विनिहते भीष्मे कौरवाणामपाकृतम्॥
en: Was that foremost of bowmen in battle capable of filling up the void created by the fall of Bhishma, the shelter of the Kurus?

sa: रामस्यानुचरा हृष्टाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा विचुक्रुशुः। अकृतव्रणप्रभृतयः काशिकन्या च भारत॥
en: All the followers of Rama, Akri avrana and others and the daughter of the king of the Kashis all set up a loud shout.

sa: स समप्रहारस्तुमुलः सम्प्रवृत्तः सुदारुणः। एकस्य च बहूनां च रथनागनरक्षयः॥
en: Thereupon, there ensued a fearful and terrible encounter between the many and the one, encounter that was destructive of many cars, elephants and men.

sa: स्तुताऽसि त्वं महादेवि विशुद्धनान्तरात्मना। जयो मे नित्यं त्वत्प्रसादाद रणाजिरे॥
en: O great goddess with my inner soul purified, I adore you. Let, through your grace, victory always attend me in the field of battle.

sa: पतितैः पात्यमानैश्च विचेष्टद्भिश्च भूतले। घोरमायोधनं जज्ञे तत्र तत्र जनेश्वर॥
en: With the fallen, the falling, and with those rolling on the grounds in agony the battle, O lord of men, became indeed very dreadful.

sa: असुरा दुदुहुर्मायामामपात्रे तु ते तदा। दोग्धा द्विमूधातत्रासीद् वत्सश्चासीद् विरोचनः॥
en: Next the Asuras milked urine from the Earth, in unbaked earthen jars. Dvimurdha (the two-headed) then became the milker and Virochana became the calf.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां सोऽतिरथो रणे। प्रवीरांस्तव सैन्येषु प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then that Atiratha checking the enemies weapons with his own weapons, dispatched many mighty heroes of the hostile rank to the regions of Death.

sa: ज्ञायमाना रणे वीर्यं घोरं गाण्डीवधन्वनः। हाहाकारकृतोत्साहा भीष्मं जग्मुः समन्ततः॥
en: Though perfectly cognisant of the dreadful prowess of the Pandava heroes with loud cries of 'Oh!' and 'Alas!' advanced towards Bhishma from all sides.

sa: ततो रणे नरव्याघ्रः पार्षतः पाण्डवैः सह। संजघानासकृद् द्रोणं विभित्सुररिवाहिनीम्॥
en: Thereafter in that battle, that foremost of men, viz., Prishata's son, supported by the Pandavas, repeatedly assailed Drona desirous of breaking through his division.

sa: गतिः पतिः समस्थाया विषमे च पिता गतिः। प्रव्रज्या हि सुदुःखेयं सुकुमार्या विशेषतः॥
en: A husband is a woman's refuge under smoother circumstances and in a difficult situation a father is the refuge; roaming about is a hard task, especially for those brought up in luxury.

sa: तुभ्यंतुभ्यमिति प्रदानिष्कान् निष्कान् सहस्रशः। ततः पुनः समाश्वास्य निष्कानेव प्रयच्छति॥
en: "To you, to you,” saying these words he gave thousands of Nishkas away to the Brahmanas. Then again, comforting them, he gave them Nishkas.

sa: गच्छ रक्षस्व हैडिम्बं संशयं परमं गतम्। भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय त्वरमाणो वृकोदरः॥
en: He yourself for rescuing the son of Hidimba involved in a great predicament.” Accepting the words of his brother, without the least delay, Vrikodara.

sa: असह्यं मन्यमानाश्च नातिप्रमनसोऽभवन्। ततस्तु नृपतिः क्रुद्धो भीमसेनं स्तनान्तरे॥ आजघान महाराज शरेणानतपर्वणा। सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासस्तेन राज्ञा महारथः॥ मूर्च्छयाऽभिपरीतात्मा ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रयत्। तांस्तु भीतान् समालक्ष्य भीमसेनं च मूर्च्छितम्॥
en: And considering it irresistible, lost their heart. Then that king the foremost of men, excited with wrath, struck Bhimasena on the centre of his chest, with a straight shaft. That mighty car-warrior and bowman, being pierced by that monarch, with his limbs stiffened in consequence of a swoon, caught hold of his flat staff. Beholding them terrified, and seeing Bhima overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु दुर्योधन कथां सहैभिर्वसुधाधिपः। यदर्थं युधि सम्प्रेक्ष्य नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्॥३।
en: Bhishma said Listen, O Duryodhana, to that story along with these rulers of the universe, namely the reason for which I shall not slay Shikhandin even though I see him in battle.

sa: सगदाद् भीमसेनाद् वा फाल्गुनाद् वा सगाण्डिवात्। न वै मोक्षस्तदाभूद् वो विना कृष्णमनिन्दृिताम्॥
en: Without the help of that praise worthy Krishna you would not have been liberated at the time, though you had the help of Bhimasena with his mace and Falguna with his Gandiva.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन शिखण्डी भरतर्षभ। अभ्यद्रवत गाङ्गेयं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Partha, and having listened to the former's worlds, Shikhandin, O foremost of the Bharatas, rushed against the son of Ganga.

sa: धिक् क्षात्रं धर्ममित्युक्त्वा प्रायात् पार्थरथं प्रति। उभौ श्वेतहयौ राजन् संसक्तौ प्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवाः॥ सिंहनादान् भृशं चक्रुः शङ्खान् दध्मुश्च मारिष। द्रौणिर्दुर्योधनश्चैव विकर्णश्च तवात्मजः॥
en: Said “Fie to Kshatriya usage” and then he went towards the car of Partha. O king, all the chiefs, then seeing both those two warriors face to face for fight with white horses yoked to their chariots, sent up a lion-like roar. They also blew their conchs. Then Drona's son and your son, Duryodhana and Vikarna.

sa: व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। ससम्भ्रमो महाराज संशयं परमं गतः॥
en: Thus involved in a perilous situation and seized with panic, O mighty monarch, that foremost of me Balhika, jumping down from his own vehicle,

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा राजन् सौभद्रश्च महारथः। हृष्टावाद्रवतां भीष्मं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Then also, O king, Dhrishtadyumna and the mighty car-warrior the son of Subhadra, filled with delight at having heard Arjuna's word, rushed against Bhishma.

sa: ह्रीमन्तः कालसम्पर्कात् सुदुःखान्यनुशेरते। हन्ति स्मात्र पिता पुत्रं रथेनाभ्येत्य संयुगे॥
en: Endued with modesty, laid themselves down with pain, their hour having come. In that battle father rushing on his car, slew his own son,

sa: एवमेतं महाव्यूहं व्यूह्य द्रोणो व्यवस्थितः। सूचीमुखे महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Thus having formed this inighty array Drona waited for the encounter. In the rear of the needle array was placed Kritavarman the fierce bowman.

sa: रथस्थान् पुरुषव्याघ्रान् पाण्डवान् प्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवाः। धृष्टद्युम्नादयः सर्वे पुनर्जहृषिरे तदा॥
en: ¡Seeing those foremost of men, the Pandavas, seated on their cars, the kings with Dhrishtadyumna and other once more sent up shouts of joy.

sa: रथानीकान्यदृश्यन्त नगराणीव भूरिशः। अतीव शुशुभे तत्र पिता ते पूर्णचन्द्रवत्॥
en: The line of chariots standing in countless number looked like so many cities, your father (Bhishma) standing there looked as brilliant as full moon.

sa: पश्यता शतशो ह्यासीदन्योन्यमभिधावताम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च साधु साध्विति नि:स्वनः॥
en: Loud shouts of Well-done' “Well-done' were uttered by hundreds of Kuru and Pandava warriors who had been looking on and rushing against one another.

sa: राक्षसं क्रूरकर्माणं भैमसेनि महाबलम्॥ भीष्मस्य निधनं प्रेप्सुं सुद्रमुखोऽभ्यद्रवद् बली।
en: Then the powerful Durmukha rushed against the highly powerful Rakshasa of fearful deeds, that son of Bhimasena who was desirous of slaying Bhishma. son

sa: अन्ये च तावका योधाः पाण्डवानां महारथान्॥ भीष्मस्याभिमुखान् यातान् वारयामासुराहवे।
en: Other warriors of your host resisted in that battle the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host as they were proceeding towards Bhishma in battle.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु सैन्यानि प्राक्रोशंस्तु पुनः पुनः॥ अभ्यद्रवत संरब्धा भीष्ममेकं महारथः।
en: Then excited to the highest pitch of fury, the mighty car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna rushed against Bhishma, repeatedly addressing the troops thus in a laud voice,

sa: त्वदीयास्तु तदा योधाः पाण्डवेयाश्च भारत। अन्योन्यं समरे जनुस्तयोस्तत्र पराक्रमे॥ शितधारैस्तथा खड्नेविमलैश्च परश्वधैः। शरैरन्यैश्च बहुभिः शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when these two were fighting with each other warriors of your side and of that of the Pandavas killed one another with sharp swords and polished battleaxes, with innumerable arrows and various kinds of other weapons.

sa: स चैवं पुरुषव्याघ्रः स्वर्गलोकमवाप्तवान्। ततोऽर्जुनो वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजेन भाषितम्॥
en: That foremost of men has also in his way, ascended to paradise.” Sanjay Said-Thus Arjuna hearing the word spoken by the virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: संजय उवाच अथ राजन् महाबाहुः सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः। विकृष्य चापं समरे भारसाहमनुत्तमम्॥ प्रामुञ्चत् पुखसंयुक्ताशरानाशीविषोपमान्। प्रगाढं लघु चित्रं च दर्शयन् हस्तलाघवम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then O king, the mighty-armed Satyaki, invincible in battle, drawing in that battle, an excellent bow capable of bearing a great strain, Discharged numerous arrows furnished with wings and resembling snakes of virulent venom, displaying at the same time his great and wonderful lightness of hands.

sa: उदेति च यतः सूर्यो यत्र च प्रतितिष्ठति॥ तत् सर्वं योवनाश्वस्य मान्धातुः क्षेत्रमुच्यते।
en: The hill where the sun rises and the hill where it sets, all the land lying between these two hills, is called the dominion of the king Mandhatri, the son of Yuvanasva.

sa: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धो विस्फार्य सुमहद् धनुः। राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबाहुविनदन् भैरवं रवम्॥
en: Thereafter excited to the highest pitch of fury, that foremost of Rakshasas possessed of mighty arms stretching his mighty bow, uttered a terrible yell.

sa: नूत्यतां श्रूयते तात गणानां सोऽद्य न स्वनः। सप्त तन्तून् वितन्वाना याजका यमुपासते॥
en: Those Yajaka Brahmanas accomplished in conducting Saptatantu sacrifices, who used to wait upon the son of Somadatta versed in the Vedas, the sound made by those Brahmanas could no longer be heard.

sa: ततोऽगुलिभ्यो हीन्द्रस्य प्रादुरासीत् पयोऽमृतम्। मां धास्यतीति कारुण्याद् यदिन्द्रो ह्यन्वकम्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon from the fingers of Indra nectareous milk flowed out. Because Indra had, out of compassion for the child, said “Let him suck me.'

sa: तेत्वनयोन्यं सुसंरन्धाः पाण्डवाः कौरवैः सह॥ अभ्यघ्नन् निशितैः शस्त्रैर्जयगृद्धाः प्रहारिणः।
en: Then, burning with wrath, the Pandavas and the Kauravas, all first-class smiters, began to pierce one another with sharpened weapons, ardently longing for victory.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य दायादा इति बीभत्सुरब्रवीत्। भीमसेनं तदा राजन् दर्शयस्व महाबलम्॥
en: "O king (look) the sons of Dhritarashtra with their counsellors look on him". O king, pointing out Bhimasena, this was what Bibhatsu (Arjuna) spoke.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौकाम्बोजं च मदक्षिणम्। भगदत्तं तथा शूरं मागधं च महाबलम्॥
en: The two Avanti princes Vinda and Anuvinda, and Sudakshina the ruler of the Kambojas, the heroic Bhagadatta, the mighty ruler of the Magadhas, son

sa: जहार सद्यो भल्लेन विपाटस्य शिरो रथात्। पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणामेकेनैव किरीटिना॥
en: Thus those three uterine bothers of Suta's son were slain by the singly-handed diademdecked Arjuna even before the very eyes of all the Dharitarashtras.

sa: स तेषां प्रवरान् योधान् हस्त्यश्वरथसादिनः। जघान समरे शूरो धार्तराष्ट्रानचिन्तयन्।॥
en: Thereat the heroic Bhima unmindful of the sons of Dhritarashtra, slow in that battle many foremost (hostile) warriors, including elephantriders, cavalry-soldiers, car-warrior and others.

sa: यथा च ब्रह्मणा बद्धं संग्रामे तारकामये। शक्रस्य कवचं दिव्यं तथा बधाम्यहं तव।।७शा
en: I do it on you, even in the same manner in which Brahman himself had put this armour of celestial make on Indra, during the battle caused by the abduction of Taraka."

sa: राम उवाच एवमेतत् कुरुश्रेष्ठ कर्तव्य भूतिमिच्छता! धर्मो ह्येष महाबाहो विशिष्टैः सह युध्यताम्॥
en: Rama said O foremost among the Kurus, such should be done by one who desires prosperity. It is virtuous, O you of long arms, to fight with those that are well known.

sa: केतुमानपि मातङ्गं विचित्रपरमाङ्कुशम्। आस्थितः समरे राजन् मेघस्थ इव भानुमान्॥
en: Ketumat also, O king, riding an elephant with a highly excellent and beautiful hook stood in the battle like the sun amidst the clouds.

sa: ततः स राजर्षिरभूद् दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। कार्यः च प्रतिपेदे तन्मनसा सुमहातपाः॥
en: Then was that royal sage filled with grief and distress and that one of great asceticism resolved, within himself, on his course of action.

sa: विस्था रथिनश्चान्ये धावमानाः समन्ततः। तत्र तत्रैव दृश्यन्ते सायुधाः साङ्गदैर्भुजैः॥
en: Many other car-warriors, deprived of their cars, were seen to rove about with their weapons in their hands and other arm adorned with Angadas.

sa: तेष्वनीकेषु भग्नेषु विद्रवत्सु समन्ततः । प्राग्ज्योतिषस्ततो भीमं कुञ्जरेण समाद्रवत्॥
en: When that host had been thus broken and rouled in all directions, the sovereign of the Pragjyotisas rushed at Bhima, riding on his elephant.

sa: अभीषाहाः शूरसेनाः शिवयोऽथ वसातयः। संग्रामे नाजहुर्भीष्मं वध्यमानाः शितैः शरैः॥
en: The Abhishahas, the Shurasenas, the Shibi's and the Vasatis, these did not avoid Bhishma through fearfully slaughtered by him in battle with whetted shafts.

sa: क्रूरः सर्वविनाशाय कालोऽसौ नातिवर्तते। अन्यथा चिन्तिता ह्या नरैस्तात मनस्विभिः॥
en: Time so cruel, that has come for destroying every one, cannot be overcome! O son, things calculated in one way even by intelligent persons.

sa: यो य इच्छेत विप्रो वै यत्र यत्रात्मनः प्रियम्। भगीरथस्तदा प्रीतस्तत्र तत्राददद् वशी॥
en: That self-controlled king Bhagiratha highly pleased used to give to the Brahmanas all their objects of desire and all things that any one of the Brahmanas used to set his hcart upon.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं तस्य सैन्यास्तव वितत्रसुः। जीमूतस्येव नदतः शक्राशनिसमस्वनम्॥
en: Hearing those shouts of Bhimnasena whose roaring resembled that of the clouds and the report of the thunder, your soldiers were filled with fear.

sa: दिश्वशान्तानि घोराणि व्याहरन्ति मृगद्विजाः। नीचैर्गध्रा निलीयन्ते भारतानां चमूं प्रति॥
en: Animals and birds are emitting fearful and inauspicious cries on all sides. The vultures are swooping down upon the mighty host of the Bharatas.

sa: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः। नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: There are (besides these) many warriors, all well-skilled in the art of war and (all) armed with various weapons, ready to die for me.

sa: श्वेतैश्छत्रैः पताकाभिर्ध्वजवारणवाजिभिः। तान्यनीकानि शोभन्ते गजैरथ पदातिभिः॥
en: O king, their troops looked splendid with white umbrella, banners, standards elephants, horses, cars and foot-soldiers.

sa: त्रैलोक्यरक्षणार्थाय ब्राह्मणा सृष्टमायुधम्। तद दिव्यमजरं चैव फाल्गुनार्थाय वै धनुः॥
en: For preserving the triune world Brahma had created a bow; that bow of celestial make and ever indestructible, was in the hands of Phalguna.

sa: किं दत्तं हुतमिष्टं वा किं सुतप्तमथो तपः। सिंधुराजो हि यैनैकः पाण्डवान् समवारयत्॥
en: What gifts did he make or what sacrifice did he accomplish or what austerities did he undergo by virtue of which he was able to resist, single-handed, the enraged sons of Pritha?

sa: स योत्स्यति हि विक्रम्य मघवानिव दानवैः। योधा ये चास्य विख्याताः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: He will fight, showing his prowess like Indra with the Danavas and those who are soldiers under him are well known names and are all well versed in the science of warfare.

sa: दुर्योधनो रणे कार्ष्णि नवभिनतपर्वभिः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः पुनश्चैनं त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana waxing worth, pierced Krishna's nephew, on the beast first with nine arrows of straight knots, and then again with three shafts.

sa: यं यं वापि स्मरन् भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्। तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः॥
en: And again, whichever from of divinity he remembers when he finally leaves this body and departs from this world, to him, O son of Kunti, he goes, having habitually meditated upon him.

sa: यशो धर्मं च कीर्तिं च पालयन् स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि। लभन्तां पाण्डवा राज्यं शमं गच्छन्तु
en: Protect your good name, your virtue and your fame. You will then be able to obtain heaven. Let the Pandavas have their kingdom and let the entire Kuru race have the peace.”

sa: मोहादेतौ न जानन्ति नरनारायणवृषी। तव पुत्रा दुरात्मानः सर्वे मन्युवशानुगाः॥
en: Your wicked sons, however, having been entangled in the meshes of death do not, out of ignorance, know them to be Nara and Narayana.

sa: संजय उवाच विरथं तं समासाद्य चित्रसेनं यशस्विनम्। रथमारोपयामास विकर्णस्तनयस्तवाशा
en: Sanjaya said Approaching the highly intelligent Chitrasena who had been deprived of his car, your son Vikarna picked him up on his own chariots.

sa: सोऽतीव सम्प्रहृष्टांस्तानुपलभ्य धनंजयः। किंचिदभ्युत्स्मयन् कृष्णमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Dhananjaya, ascertaining them to be excessively delighted, said these words to Krishna, smiling the while.

sa: छाद्यमानस्तु नागैः स ध्यात्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः। सौपर्ण रूपमास्थाय भक्षयामास पन्नगान्॥
en: Thus surrounded by the Nagas, that foremost of the Rakshasas, reflecting for a while, assumed the form of Garuda and devoured all those serpents.

sa: ये चाप्युक्ता मयि गुणा भवद्भिर्जयकाक्षिभिः। चिकीर्षुस्तानहं सर्वान् योधयिष्यामि पाण्डवान्॥
en: Those qualities, which, you, desirous of victory, have ascribed to me, bringing them to play, I will offer battle to the sons of Pandu.

sa: रक्ष्या मे सततं देवाः सहेन्द्राः सद्विजातयः। त्वष्टः सुदुर्धरं तेजो येन वृत्रो विनिर्मितः॥
en: The celestials with Indra at their head, as also the regenerate order are ever deserving of my protection. But the energy of Tvashtri from which Vritra has been created is indeed irrepressible.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा रुक्मदण्डां दुरासदाम्। चिच्छेद समरे भीष्मः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: But in that combat Bhishma cut off with his straight arrows that lances furnished with a golden staff as it coursed swiftly towards himself.

sa: योऽन्वयो मातृकस्तस्य स एनमभिपेदिवान्। स नागैर्बहुभी राजन्निरावान् संवृतो रणे॥
en: A Naga related to him through his mother came to his support; surrounded on all side by numerous Nagas, O king, in that battle,

sa: नाकारो गृहितुं शक्यो बृहस्पतिसमैरपि। तस्मात्तव सुतो राजन् प्रहृष्टो वाक्यमव्रवीत्॥
en: Even beings like Brihaspati himself cannot suppress the outward manifestations of internal feelings. Therefore, O menarch, your son, transported with joy, spoke these words.

sa: द्रवमाणे च भीते च तवास्मीति च वादिनि' स्त्रियां स्त्रीनामधेये न विवले चैकपरिणे॥
en: One who lays his weapons aside, one who is fallen, one whose armour and standard have been shattered, one who flies away, one who is panic-struck, one who say “I am yours”

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य इरावानपि राक्षसम्। विमोहयित्वा मायाभिस्तस्य गात्राणि सायकैः॥ चिच्छेद सर्वमर्मज्ञः कामरूपो दुरासदः। तथा स राक्षसश्रेष्ठः शरैः कृत्तः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon mounting on the sky, that unapproachable hero Iravat, versed in all duty and capable of assuming any from at will, confounding with his illusive powers that Rakshasa, cut off the latter's limbs in that battle. Thus was that foremost of Rakshasas cut into pieces again and again.

sa: विललाप सुदुःखार्तो बहुधा करुणं नृपः। विलपन्तं निशम्याथ पुत्रशोकहतं नृपम्॥
en: King Srinjaya began to lament plaintively being afflicted with terrible grief. Hearing the king afflicted with grief caused by his son's death thus lament.

sa: हाहेति दिवि देवानां पार्थिवानां च भारत॥ पतमाने बभूव सुमहास्वनः।
en: Then at the overthrow of Bhishma loud lamentations of “Alas" and "Oh" were heard,O Bharata, among the kings, and the celestial in the heaven.

sa: पश्य मे विक्रमं राजन् महेन्द्रस्येव संयुगे। विमुञ्चन्त महास्त्रागि पातायष्यामि तं रथात ॥
en: Behold, O king, my rowess in battle, o be cqual to that of tl.. great Indra himself. I will overthrow nim (Bhishma) from lus car, in spite of his shooting mighty weapons.

sa: मय्येव दण्डः पतति दैवात् परमदारुणः। यथाऽवध्याः पाण्डुसुता यथा वध्याश्च मे सुताः॥ एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व याथातथ्येन संजय। न हि पारं प्रपश्यामि दुःखस्यास्य कथंचन॥
en: Through the disposal of Destiny, a highly severe chastisement has overtaken me alone. Tell me truly, O Sanjaya, every thing, about why my sons have become liable to slaughter and why the sons of Pandus have been exempted from it. I can not discern, O afflicter of your enemies, the termination of this ocean of distress.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यद्येवं नाभिगच्छेथा युधि मां पृथिवीपते। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Oruler of earth, O great king, O descendant of Bharata, if you had not come to me in this battle, I would have cursed you for bringing about your defeat.

sa: तथा ते समरेऽन्योन्यं निघ्नन्तः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। रक्तोक्षिता घोररूपा विरेजुर्दानवा इव॥
en: Those foremost of Kshatriya struck one another in battle. They became terrible to look at. covered with blood, they shone like the Kinshuka flowers.

sa: भीमसेनः सुसंक्रुद्धः परासुकरणं दृढम्। चित्रं कार्मुकमादत्त शरांश्च निशितान् दश॥
en: Excited with wrath, Bhimasena grasped a variegated bow of tough make, capable of depriving the foe of his life, as also ten sharp arrows.

sa: पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं धनुषो गाण्डिवस्य च। ध्वजं च दृष्ट्वा पार्थस्य सर्वान् नो भयमाविशत्॥
en: Hearing the blare of the conch Panchajanya, and the twang of the bow Gandiva, and seeing the standard of the son of Pritha (Arjuna), every one of us was seized with terror.

sa: वत्स पर्याप्तमेतावद् भीष्मेण सह संयुगे। विमर्दस्ते महाबाहो व्यपयाहि रणादितः॥
en: What time you have fought with Bhishma has been enough, O son. 0 you of mighty arms, desist from this combat, leave the battlefield.

sa: भीष्मस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठो भीमसेन महाबलम्। अवारयत संक्रुद्धः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Then that foremost of car warriors namely Bhishma, waxing worth opposed Bhimasena of great prowess even before the very eyes of the assembled troops.

sa: पर्याप्तमेतद् भद्रं ते तव कार्मुकधारणम्। विसर्जयैतद् दुर्धर्ष तपस्तप्यस्व भार्गव॥
en: Blessing be to you, let this be enough of taking up the bow. But desist from this now, O invincible Practice austerities, 0 Bhargava.

sa: तस्माद् देवव्रतं भूयो वधोपायार्थमात्मनः। भवता सहिताः सर्वे प्रयाम मधुसूदन॥
en: Therefore once more accompanied by you, Oslayer of Madhu, we shall repair to Bhishma for inquiring of him the means of his own death.

sa: तानुवाच महाबाहुर्भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः। स्वागतं तव वार्ष्णेय स्वागतं ते धनंजय॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Bhishma the grandsire of the Kurus thus addressed them saying “All hail, O you of Vrishni's race, all hail, O Dhananjaya.

sa: शल्यस्तु समरे जिष्णु क्रीडन्निव महारथः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then in that battle, the mighty car-warrior Shalya inflamed with wrath, pierced, as if sporting, Vishnu on the breast with broadheaded and straight-knotted shafts.

sa: शरैराशीविषाकारैः पुत्रं तव विशाम्पते॥ पुत्रोऽपि तव दुर्धर्षो द्रौपद्यास्तनयान रणे। सायकैर्निशितै राजन्नाजघान पृथक् पृथक्॥ तैश्चापि विद्धः शुशुभे रुधिरेण समुक्षितः।
en: Your son; and O monarch, every one them pierced him with three shafts each. Your invincible son, O monarch, in that conflict, pierced the sons of Draupadi separately with arrows of exceeding sharpness. Pierced with their arrows in return and bespattered with blood, he (Duryodhana) appeared highly beautiful.

sa: प्रमोहः सर्वसत्त्वानामतीव समपद्यत। रजसा चाभिभूतानामस्त्रजालैश्च तुद्यताम्॥
en: All the warriors, overwhelmed with that dust and fighting with their various weapons, were greatly confounded.

sa: आरुरोह रथं राजंश्चित्रसेनस्य भारत॥ स्थितावेकरथे तौ तु भ्रातरौ कुलवर्धनौ।
en: Ascended, O king, the resplendent car of Chitrasena; them thus seated on the same chariot, namely those two brothers the perpetuator of Kuru's race.

sa: मृता इति च शब्दोऽयं वर्तते च ततोऽर्थवत्। इमे मृता महीपाला: प्रायशो भीमविक्रमाः॥
en: The significance of the word 'Death' hastoday been clearly brought home (to our minds), as almost all these rulers of earth possessed of fierce prowess, lie dead on the field of battle.

sa: सम्पातं समुदीर्णं च दर्शयामास पाण्डवः॥ केचिदचासिना छिन्नाः पाण्डवेन महात्मना।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he was seen to rush forward and rush upward. Some, mangled by that illustrious son of Pandu with his sword,

sa: शिखण्डिने च मुदितः प्रादाद् वित्तं जनेश्वरः। हस्तिनोऽश्वांश्चगाश्चैव दास्योऽथ बहुलास्तथा॥
en: And that lord of men gave away with joy to Shikhandin great wealth, and elephants, horses and cattle and slaves also in large numbers.

sa: पुष्करेष्वथ गोकर्णे नैमिषे मलये तथा अपाकर्षत् स्वकं देहं नियमैर्मानसप्रियैः॥
en: Thence going to Puskara and Gokarna and Naimisha and Malaya, she pulled her health down by the practice of penances after her own choice.

sa: अभिमानस्य दर्पस्य क्रोधपारुष्ययोस्तथा। नैष्ठुर्यस्यावलेपस्य आत्मसम्भावनस्य च॥
en: Of too much pride, vanity and of anger and harsh words, of enmity, arrogance and boasts,

sa: सगदाद् भीमसेनाद् वा पार्थाद् वापि सगाण्डिवात्। न वै मोक्षस्तदा वोऽभूद् विना कृष्णामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: Without the help of that praise worthy Krishna you would not have been liberated at the time, though you had the help of Bhimasena with his mace and Falguna with his Gandiva.

sa: स्वसेनया च सहितः सुशर्मा प्रस्थलाधिपः। वामपक्षं समाश्रित्य दंशितः समवस्थितः॥
en: Susharma the ruler of Prasthala, clad in mail and supported by his own division stationing himself in its left wing, stood ready for battle.
